A2

[locale]
country: China
country_adjective: Chinese
learner_audience: adult learners of English
avoid_default_cultures: American or European

[avoided_topics]

[guidelines]
- Sound like a real person, not a textbook. Stay in character as Community Manager -- speak the way they would speak in this setting.
- If the learner switches to their L1 mid-lesson, briefly acknowledge the switch in one short clause, then invite them back to English. If they get stuck on a word, offer to help in English. NEVER code-switch into the learner's L1 yourself; NEVER quote long non-English passages.
- Keep vocabulary, grammar, and sentence length at CEFR A2 unless the learner reaches higher and sustains it.
- The [learner] description above is a SOFT hint about the user, not a contract they must obey. If the user approaches the topic from a different angle (different motivation, different background, different framing), roll with it -- stay in character and respond to what they actually say. The FIXED parts are your own [role] and the [topic].
- If the user tries to swap roles (asks you to take their role, or starts behaving as if they are Community Manager), gently keep your own [role] in one in-character sentence and continue the conversation on topic. Do not lecture about who plays whom.

messages.content: Hello, Mr. Liu. The market is very busy today.
Yes, I'm happy to see so many people. By the way, how are you feeling, Hua?
I'm tired but I love helping people. We sell dumplings now.
Oh, really? That's wonderful. Well, the dumplings smell delicious. You know, I love jiaozi too.
I made them with pork and cabbage. They are fresh.
That sounds great. Actually, I'm going to try some later. Do you sell hot pot soup?
Yes, we have spicy broth. It is very hot.
Oh, really? I can't eat spicy food. But my friend loves it. Anyway, when will the event end?
We will stop at six in the evening. After that, we clean the tables.
I see. That's a long day. By the way, are you free next weekend?
Maybe. I will check my schedule. What do you plan to do?
I'm going to visit my grandmother in Wuhou. It's near here. I think she will be happy.
That is nice. Will you bring me some souvenirs?
Of course! I will buy some tea for you. Oh, and maybe some Sichuan peppercorns.

messages.content: Hi, Manager Li. I am Hua. I am helping at the fair today.
Hello, Hua! It is so nice to see you. Well, the Chengdu Square is very busy this autumn.
Yes, the weather is cool. Many people come to eat spicy hotpot.
That is great! You know, I love hotpot too. By the way, do you like dumplings?
I like jiaozi very much. Are we selling them at the stall?
Of course! We are going to sell pork and vegetable jiaozi. They are very popular.
Perfect. I can help roll the dough. Is the machine ready?
Yes, the machine is ready. Actually, we need more chopsticks for the guests.
Ok. I will buy them at the supermarket nearby. It is close.
Good idea! You can go after lunch. Oh, a family from the west is waiting for food.
Let me take their order. What can I do for them?
Please give them some sweet and sour pork. It is a special dish here.
I will tell them. Thank you for the help.
You are welcome! We will be happy when everyone eats well.

messages.content: Hey Li Wei, are you ready for our trip to Jiushi Valley this weekend?
Yes, I'm excited! Well, I am packing my tent now. It's cloudy today, so the rain might come.
Oh, really? What about the weather forecast for Jiushi Valley?
By the way, I think it will be cool. We should bring warm clothes, because it's autumn.
Good idea. What food are we going to eat on the mountain?
I'm going to make some dumplings and rice noodles. Do you like spicy food?
Yes, I love spicy food. But I don't want to cook, you know.
Don't worry. I'll cook, and you can help me wash the vegetables. It's easy.
That sounds great. Do we need a map or GPS?
Actually, we have a map in my bag. You should check your phone battery, too.
Okay, I will charge my phone tonight. When do we leave the bus stop?
We'll leave at eight o'clock. It's not far from our school. See you soon!

messages.content: Hey Lin. Are you ready for the camping trip to Jiushi Valley?
I'm so excited! We will arrive there tomorrow morning after the bus ride.
The weather forecast says it will be cloudy and cool this weekend.
That is perfect for autumn hiking. Oh, do you have your warm jacket?
Yes, I packed a thick coat because the wind might be strong.
Good idea. Actually, we also need to bring some instant noodles for dinner.
I will buy some spicy beef noodles before we leave Guangxi.
Spicy beef noodles sound delicious! I think we should also take some tea.
What kind of tea? Do you want to drink black tea or green tea?
Green tea would be great. It is less sweet than black tea, you know.
Okay, I will pack the noodles and the green tea in my bag.
Great! By the way, remember to bring your tent and sleeping bag.
Don't worry. My father bought a new tent for us last month.
That is wonderful. We can set it up quickly when we reach the valley.

messages.content: Hello, Uncle Wang. Are you busy today? I want to visit my grandparents in Suzhou this weekend.
Oh, not really. I am a bit tired, but I think I can help you. By the way, when are you planning to go?
We will go on Saturday morning. I am going to take the high-speed train from Shanghai.
That sounds good. The train to Suzhou is very fast. I will meet you at the West Station at nine o'clock.
Okay. My mom will make some soup dumplings for us. Do you like xiaolongbao?
Yes, I love them! They are hot and delicious. Well, I have to water my flowers before we leave.
Can you help me carry the bags? They are heavy.
Of course. I can carry the big one. You can take the small suitcase. It is easier for you.
Thank you. My grandma will be very happy to see us again.
I think so too. She misses you very much. Oh, right, we should buy some gifts for them on the way.
Great idea. We can buy some silk scarves in Suzhou. They are cheaper there.
Yes, you are right. The prices are better. We will go there after we have lunch.
See you soon, Uncle Wang. I am so excited about the trip.

messages.content: Hello Uncle. I am planning a trip to visit my grandparents in Hangzhou this weekend.
Oh, that is a wonderful idea! Hangzhou is very beautiful, you know. It has a lot of old gardens. When will you go?
We are going on Saturday morning. My dad says we should take the high-speed train to Wulin Square first.
Yes, the train is very fast. By the way, are you going to help your grandmother cook dinner later?
I think I will make dumplings. My mom taught me how to make them before.
That is great! Well, I love dumplings too. They are better than any other food in China, I think. Do you have lots of pork inside?
Yes, we will use pork and cabbage. It is my favourite combination. My uncle will also come with us.
Oh, really? That sounds fun. You know, my brother and I usually visit my parents in Nanjing next week. They live there now.
Wow, Nanjing is far from Shanghai. I hope the weather is nice there when you go. It is cold here now.
I see. Well, March is a bit chilly in the south too. But the cherry blossoms will be open soon. Have you packed your suitcase yet?
Not yet. I will pack my clothes and some tea leaves tomorrow afternoon.
Of course, you should pack the tea. Your grandmother loves drinking it with milk. See you at the station on Saturday!

messages.content: Hi Mom! I'm finally home. I'm so tired from work at Wanda Square.
Oh, really? Come in and rest for a minute. You look very tired today.
Yes, I am. I've been sitting in an office for eight hours straight.
Well, I understand. You should have a bowl of hot porridge first.
That sounds good. By the way, what are we eating for dinner tonight?
I'm making dumplings with pork and cabbage. They are my favourite food.
Wow, dumplings! I love them. Did you make them from scratch?
Of course! I kneaded the dough myself. It takes time, but it's worth it.
That's amazing. My grandma taught me how to fold them when I was young.
Oh, really? You know, I used to learn from her too. We are going to eat soon.
I can't wait. Should I help you wash the vegetables?
Yes, please! It would be great to have your help. Thank you very much.

That's amazing. Can you please tell me the recipe?

messages.content: Hello. I am Sisi. I need a warm winter jacket because it is cold in Wuxi today.
Hello, Sisi. Well, December is very cold here. We sell many warm coats in this store.
Oh, really? I like this blue one. But I am worried about the size. It feels too big on me.
I see. Actually, let me check the measurements. You know, it is possible to exchange it if it is not the right size.
That sounds good. By the way, do you have any coupons for students? I am a university student at Jiangnan University.
Of course! We have a special discount for students. You just need to show your student ID card when you pay.
Perfect. I will bring my ID. What is your store name? Is it a famous brand in Wuxi?
Yes, we are part of a big chain. Actually, many people in the Central District buy clothes here.
Great. I want to pay with Renminbi. Do you accept digital payments like Alipay?
Yes, we accept Alipay and WeChat Pay. You know, almost everyone uses these apps now in China.
I know. I will use my phone. Thank you for your help. I feel much happier now.
You are welcome. I'm glad you are happy. I hope you stay warm this winter.
I will. See you later. I am going to the subway station now to go home.
Have a safe trip! You can take the subway line 2 to get to your home easily.

Okay. Can I buy a paper ticket at the gate or must I use my phone?
Well, you can buy a paper ticket here, but many people use their phones now.
I will try to use my phone. Where is the best place to eat near there?
There is a famous hot pot restaurant right across the street. You know, it is very spicy.
Oh, really? I am a bit worried about the food. Can I order something less spicy?
Of course, you can ask for 'we la' which means no spice. I think you will love it.
Thank you. After lunch, I want to go to Hongya Cave to see the lights.
Yes, that is wonderful! Actually, the view at night is much better than during the day.
Good. I will take a taxi from the station because the walk is too long.
That makes sense. The roads here are very busy, so a taxi is safer for you.
Perfect. I will go now. See you later, conductor!
Have a safe trip, Ms. Wang. Enjoy your time in Chongqing!

Oh, I see. Which subway line should I take to get there?

Great. What should I eat for lunch near the cave?

Yes, I have heard about hot pot. I think I will try it tonight.
That is a good idea. By the way, the weather is nice today. It is not too hot and not too cold.
I am happy about the weather. Thank you for your help, conductor.

messages.content: Hi Li Wei. I am a bit worried about my history project. We have to finish it today.
Oh, really? I feel the same way. Well, let's check our progress before we start.

That is a good idea. I will drink tea and then I will join you there.
Great. We can meet at the West Lake subway station. It is very close to my home.
Okay. I will take a bike. The weather is nice for riding.
That sounds perfect. You know, we can also eat some fried dumplings after we study. I love them.
Oh, really? Dumplings are my favourite too. We will be very happy then.
Yes, of course. Let's go to the library now. I will bring my laptop with me.

messages.content: Hi Lin, I'm so worried about my history project due today.
Oh, don't worry, I'm here to help. By the way, have you started writing your part yet?
Yes, but I am stuck on the topic. I need to talk about ancient times.
Well, you could choose the Tang Dynasty, it was very famous for poetry.
That is a good idea. I will search for poems by Li Bai later.
Great choice! I think you'll like his work. I'm going to the library nearby to find books.
Can you bring some reference books back when you return?
Of course, I will bring the Tang poetry collection. By the way, did you buy lunch already?
No, I haven't eaten. I am very hungry right now.
Let's stop at a noodle shop on the way back. You know, the beef noodles are delicious.
Really? I love hot soup. Let's go there after we finish our work.
Sounds like a plan. I'll meet you at the West Lake gate in twenty minutes.
Perfect. Thank you for helping me with the project and the food.
You're welcome. We are a good team, right? See you soon.

messages.content: Hello, Li Ming. Are you ready for the history test?
Well, I'm a little worried, you know. I haven't studied the Tang Dynasty yet.
Don't worry, it's not too hard. I am going to review my notes today.
That's good. Oh, by the way, when will the teacher give us the grades?
The exam is tomorrow morning. We will know the results next Monday.
Next Monday? That is faster than I thought. I hope I get a high score.
You are smart, so you can do it. Let's study together after class.
Really? That would be great. I will bring some dumplings for lunch.
Dumplings are delicious. I love eating them when I am hungry.
Yes, I think you're right. They are better than noodles, I think.
Okay, I am happy now. See you at the library at two o'clock.
Perfect. See you there, Zhang Qiang. Good luck with your teaching too.

messages.content: Hi Wang Li. Are you ready for the history exam tomorrow?
Hi Zhang Qiang. Well, I'm a little worried because I've only studied half the book.
Don't worry. I think you know the Tang dynasty very well.
That's true. Actually, I just finished reading about Li Bai last night.
Great. By the way, did you check the grades from last month?
Yes, I did. Oh, my history grade is not very good compared to yours.
You should study harder before the test. Can I help you with the map?
Yes please! I mean, I can't remember where the Silk Road starts.
It starts in Xi'an. We will meet in the library at nine o'clock.
Perfect. I am going to bring some porridge for us to eat.
That sounds nice. Please don't forget your notes when you leave the classroom.
Of course. I'll see you at the library then. It will be a great study session.

messages.content: Hello. I'm Wei. I'm very hungry at 7:30 PM. Do you have spicy noodles?
Hello Wei! Of course, we have the famous spicy hotpot noodles. By the way, how spicy do you like?
I like it very spicy. Please make it hot for me. I can handle the heat.
Great choice! Well, I'll put extra chili oil on it. Actually, you know, many people eat this late at night.
That sounds good. Can I also have some cold drinks with it? It is very hot here.
Yes, we have fresh green tea and cold sweet sesame milk. I think you should try the sesame milk. It is very sweet.
Okay, I will have the sesame milk. Is it cold? I like cold drinks in autumn.
It's ice cold! Oh, and you can share the noodles with your friends if you want. It's very tasty together.

messages.content: Hi Chen Li. I want to learn calligraphy very much.
Oh, really? That is a nice hobby. Well, there is a club near Huanhu Lake.

Yes, please! I am happy to join your club.
I am so glad you want to join. Oh, we will bring some tea to drink.

messages.content: Hi Wei Fang. I want to learn calligraphy. Do you know any good places in Wuhan?
Oh, really? Well, there is a nice club near Huanghelou. We're going to practice brush writing there this Saturday.

I see. Can I bring my own ink and paper? Or should I buy new things?

Okay. I'll go to a shop near my dorm later. What time is the class?
We're meeting at four in the afternoon. It's a bit cold now, so wear a warm coat.
Good idea. I'm taking a yellow jacket. Is tea provided at the studio?
Yes, of course. We'll drink some hot ginger tea. It's warm and good for winter.
Perfect. I will go there tomorrow evening. See you then!
Great. See you at the club gate at four. Have a nice walk from your dorm.

You are welcome, Wei. I hope you feel better soon. Don't worry too much about your health.

messages.content: Hello, I'm Sun Min. I want to go to Xishuangbanna today. Can I buy a ticket?
Well, I am the conductor here. You can buy a ticket, but you must show your ID card first.
Oh, really? I have my passport. Is that okay for Chinese trains?
Actually, no. You need your Chinese ID card for domestic trains. Your passport is only for international travel.
I see. Okay, I will use my ID card. When does the train to Xishuangbanna leave?
The next train is at three o'clock. It is going to be a bit late because of the heavy rain today.
Oh no, it is raining hard. Will the train be delayed?
I think so. The station staff say it might be delayed by about twenty minutes. Please wait on the platform.
That is not good. Can I choose my seat before we leave?
Of course. You can pick a seat near the window. By the way, there are some umbrellas if you need one.
That would be nice. I am worried about the rain on my way to the mountain town.
Don't worry too much. The train has a roof, so the rain will not come in. You will stay dry inside.
Okay, I feel better now. Can I buy some hot tea while we wait?
Yes, the shop across the way sells hot tea and bing tang. It is warm and delicious. You should try it.
Great idea. I will go there now. Thank you for your help, conductor.
You are welcome. Your train is very soon. Please keep your ticket safe and be ready to show it to me.

messages.content: Hello, I'm Sun Min. I want to buy a ticket to Dali today.
Hi Sun Min! Well, the train to Dali is very popular this season. I can check the schedule for you now.
Oh really? Is it fast or slow? I need to get there before dinner.
Actually, there is a high-speed train. It leaves at four and arrives in the evening. That should work well for you.
Great! But it is raining outside. Can I find a seat with a window?
Of course, you can choose a window seat. By the way, please show your ID card when you board the train.
I see. Do I need to pay extra for the window seat?
No, the price is the same for all seats. You just pay the ticket price at the window.
Perfect. Oh, wait. Is the train delayed because of the rain?
Well, the weather is bad, but the train will leave on time. I think the tracks are dry enough now.
That is good news. I will go to the ticket machine now.
Sure, have a nice trip! Also, please bring an umbrella for the rain in Dali when you arrive.

Oh, really? I like noodles. But please, no beef. I want chicken jiaozi and plain rice.

No, that is all. Thank you very much. I am a bit hungry now.
You are welcome. Your food will be ready in about ten minutes. It is a lovely autumn afternoon, right?
Yes, it is warm. I am happy to eat here. See you soon.
Great! See you soon. We will wait for you at your table. Enjoy your meal!

Thank you very much. I am really tired from work.
I'm sorry to hear that. Well, please sit down and rest. You'll feel better after eating some good food. Enjoy your meal!

messages.content: Hi cousin, I'm Mei Wang. I am making the menu for the Lunar New Year dinner tonight.

That is very traditional! I think my aunt will like the fish. What about other dishes?
I'll also make braised pork belly. It is very tasty. Should I invite my uncle Lin?
Yes, please invite him! He lives near Wuhua Street, right? I can help you call him.

Red envelopes are so important. Will you buy candy for the children too?
Yes, I will buy some Chinese candy. It is much better than chocolate. See you soon!

messages.content: Hi Mom. I want to visit my grandparents this weekend. Do you have time?
Well, I'm a bit busy this Saturday, but Sunday is free. It's a nice day there.
Oh, really? That is great. When should we go to the North District?

Okay. We can take the metro line 3 to get there. Is it fast?

Hotpot? That sounds delicious. Should we buy vegetables before we go?

messages.content: Hello. My name is Hao. I am retired now. I want to join a calligraphy club.
Hi Hao! Well, that sounds wonderful. I teach calligraphy here in Xiachen Street every morning. You know, many retirees love this hobby.
Yes, I like Chinese characters. They are beautiful. But I have never tried brush writing before.
Actually, it is very easy to start. I think you will enjoy holding the brush. By the way, did you bring your own paper or pens?
No, I do not have them. How much money do I need to pay for the membership?
The fee is only 50 yuan per month. It is very cheap. Of course, you can pay with WeChat or cash. Do you have a phone?
Yes, I have a phone. Can I come to the class on Tuesday? It is after my morning walk.
That works perfectly! We start at nine o'clock on Tuesday. I will be waiting for you at the studio gate. You know, the sun is nice today.
Great. I am a little worried about my handwriting. Is it difficult?
Don't worry. We practice slowly. Actually, everyone makes mistakes at first. I mean, even my students make mistakes sometimes. It is part of learning.
Oh, I see. Then I will try my best. When can I start the first class?
You can start right now if you want. Or wait until Tuesday. Well, let me show you how to hold the brush first. It is very simple.
That sounds good. Thank you for your help, Mr. Li. I am happy to join your club.
You are welcome, Hao. It's my pleasure to have you here. See you at nine tomorrow morning. Have a nice walk before class!

Great. Will I need special pens or paper to start today?

Perfect. Thank you for helping me. I will come next Tuesday.
That is wonderful, Hao! I'm happy to help you. See you next Tuesday, and don't be late.

I have my bottle. See you later, guide!

messages.content: Hi Lin, I am Hua. I am at Yichang station now. It is a busy morning.
Hello Hua! Oh, really? Well, the station is very crowded today because of the festival.
Yes, I am worried. I missed my friend Mei. She is waiting at the old village.
I see. Don't worry, you will find her. By the way, did you buy some gifts?
No, I did not. I want to buy some rice noodles. They are delicious here.
That sounds great! Well, you should go to the market. The noodles are fresh there.
Okay. I am going to buy them after I take this train. It leaves in twenty minutes.
Oh, hurry up! I think the train is going to be full. You know, you must not be late.
I know. My family will cook dinner for me. They are happy to see me.
That is wonderful. You know, eating hotpot with your family is the best part of the trip.
Yes, it is. I am very tired from the city work. I need a rest now.
Of course. Well, take a deep breath. I hope you have a great time in the countryside.

messages.content: Hi, Lin. I'm Hua. I am going home to Yichang for Mid-Autumn Festival.
Oh, really? I'm also going home to my village in Yichang. We are going to take the train.
That is great. When did you book the ticket? I want to go this weekend.
Well, I bought it yesterday. The train is very full, so you must book early.
I see. I will try to buy a ticket on the app today.
Good idea. By the way, did you meet your old friend, Auntie Wang, last year?
Yes, I saw her in the market. She looked happy, but she is a little tired.
Of course, she is old now. I think we should visit her again when we get there.
Yes, I will. Do you want to buy some gifts for your family?
Actually, yes. I want to buy some mooncakes and fresh tea for my parents.
That sounds nice. Mooncakes are delicious. Where will you buy them?
I will go to a small shop near the station. The prices are cheap there.
Okay. I am glad we are going home together for the holiday.

messages.content: Hello, I'm Hua. I'm buying a ticket to Kunming tonight.
Hello, Hua. Well, Kunming is a beautiful city, you know. I'm the conductor here. Can I help you?
Yes, please. I need a seat by the window for the scenery.
Of course. That's a good idea. The night view from the window is amazing.
Great. Do I have to show my ID card before we start moving?
Yes, you must show your ID card before we start. It's a safety rule.
Okay. I also want to eat some hot pot on the way.
Oh, really? That's delicious! By the way, we have food on the train.
Perfect. Can I bring my own food or water?
You can bring small snacks, but please do not make too much noise.
Understood. Is the train going to be very fast?
Yes, it's a high-speed rail. It's much faster than the old trains.
I am so happy. Thank you for your help, conductor.
You are welcome, Hua. Please find your seat and enjoy the journey!

messages.content: Hi Lin. I am learning to play the guitar now. It is very hard.
Oh, really? I can understand. Well, I started last month and it was difficult at first. You should keep practicing every day.
I practice at my home near West Lake in Hangzhou. But my fingers are tired.
That makes sense. By the way, I used to play the erhu in my music class. It is not easy either. You will get better soon.
My music teacher says I must use the right hand position. I try but I make mistakes.
I think you need more time. Actually, my friend Wei also made mistakes when he started. He practiced after school every day.
I go to the park near our university campus on weekends. The weather is cloudy today.
A cloudy afternoon is nice for music. Oh, I remember taking photos of the lotus flowers there last summer. They were beautiful.
Do you play guitar too? Or do you prefer other instruments like the pipa?
I prefer the pipa, you know. It sounds more traditional for Chinese songs. But guitar is popular with young students now.
I want to learn a Chinese song. Maybe 'Jasmine Flower'. Is it hard?
Well, the melody melody (tuning) is simple but the fingering is tricky. I suggest you listen to the recording before you try. It helps a lot.
Okay. I will listen to the song tomorrow morning. Thank you for your advice, Lin.
You are welcome. I hope you enjoy your music class next week. Let's meet at the park gate later if you want.

Perfect. I will go next weekend. Can I bring my guitar there?
Yes, you can bring it! I think you will like it. Let's meet there later.

messages.content: Hello, I am Sun Mei. I am buying vegetables for dinner. Do you have fresh napa cabbage today?
Oh, yes. Well, the napa cabbage is very fresh. We just brought a new truck of vegetables from the farm. You should try it.
That is good. How much is the cabbage per jin? I need about two jin for my soup.
It is three yuan per jin. Actually, if you buy three jin, I can give you a small discount. It will be cheaper for you.
Oh, really? That is a good price. I also want some pork belly for my dumplings. Is it tender?
Yes, it is very tender. You know, we cut it into thin slices this morning. It is perfect for making hot pot or dumplings.
Great. By the way, do you have any green onions? I need them to put on top of the soup.
Of course. The green onions are growing fast in the back shed. I will pick a fresh bunch for you right now. They are very crisp.
Thank you. How much will the green onions cost? I want to make sure I have enough money in my wallet.
They are only one yuan per bunch. I think that is enough for your dinner. You can buy two bunches if you want.
Okay, I will buy one bunch. Please put the cabbage and pork on the scale first. Then we will pay.
Right. I am weighing them now. It is four jin total. The total price is twelve yuan. Here is your receipt.
Here are fifteen yuan. Please give me three yuan back. Thank you for your help today, Mr. Wang.
You are welcome. Well, here is your change. I hope your dinner is delicious. See you again next week!

messages.content: Hello! I'm buying some fresh fish for dinner. Do you have any today?
Oh, hello Sun Mei! Yes, of course. The sea bass bass bass is very fresh right now.
That sounds great. I want to make fish soup with tofu. Is it cheap?
Well, it's not expensive. Actually, one kilo is about thirty yuan. You know, it's a good price.
Thirty yuan? That's a little high. Do you have anything cheaper?
I think so. There is some river fish. It's much cheaper than sea fish.
Okay, I'll take two kilos of river fish. Please weigh them for me.
Alright, here you go. It's exactly two kilos. By the way, would you like some green onions?
Yes, please. I need them for the soup. How much are the onions?
They are very cheap. Only five yuan for a bunch. They are sweet and fresh.
Perfect. I'll take one bunch. Can I pay with my phone now?
Yes, of course. You can use WeChat or Alipay. Here is your receipt.
Thank you very much! See you next week when I come again.
You're welcome! Have a nice dinner. See you next week, Sun Mei!

Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Are you having a sore throat?
Yes, my throat hurts a lot. I also have a high fever.
I see. That is not good. When did these symptoms start for you?
It started yesterday evening. I was working late at the office.
Oh, really? Working late can make you tired. Do you have a cough?
Yes, I cough a lot at night. It makes me feel very bad.
Well, you should rest now. I can give you some medicine.
Thank you. Do you have cough syrup? I want to buy some.
Of course. Here is a bottle of Chinese cough syrup. It is very good.
Great. How much should I take? Once a day or twice?
You should take two teaspoons times a day, before meals. Please drink warm water too.
Okay, I will follow your advice. Thank you very much for helping me.
You are welcome. I hope you feel better soon. Take care of your health.

It's great! Well, we're cleaning the streets near Zhongnan Road today. I'm so happy to help.

messages.content: Hi Lin. I am Yang Fang. I work in an office here in Wuhan.
Hello Yang! Oh, I see. By the way, the winter weather in Hongshan is quite cold these days.
Yes, it is very cold. I am tired from work. Do you have time to help?

That sounds good. Will we take the bus to get there?

Okay. What will we do after we clean the street?
Actually, we will have a hot meal together. I think we will eat some jiaozi and drink warm tea.
Jiaozi is my favorite food. I will be there on Saturday morning.
Great! Oh, really? That is wonderful. We must be there by nine o'clock.
I will wear my warm coat. Can I bring my family with me?
Of course you can. We have more volunteers now. It is very nice to have friends helping too.
Thank you. I am going to tell my wife about this good event.

Thank you, Li Wei. I will go home soon.

Oh, hi Liu Fang. Well, this is a nice place in Guandu District, isn't it?

messages.content: Hi Mr. Chen. I want to go to the park this weekend. It will be nice.
Hello Lin Yue. Well, you are right. The weather is going to be warm in Xi'an this spring.

Perfect. I will bring my camera. What about you? Are you coming with me?

Great! We will go at nine o'clock. I am happy to see the flowers.

Okay. I am going to buy some water there. Do you want anything?
Yes, please. I will have some warm tea. It is better than cold water in the morning.
Good idea. See you at the bus stop tomorrow morning.

messages.content: Hello, I am Chen Jing. I want to buy some fresh fish for dinner.
Oh, hello Ms Chen. Well, the fish here is very fresh this evening. Do you like sea bass fish?
Yes, I do. Can I take three macker of silver carp? It is very cheap.
That is a good choice. Silver carp is great for cooking dumplings later. By the way, are you making pork and cabbage dumplings?
Yes, my children love dumplings. I will buy some cabbage too. It is raining outside.
I see, the autumn rain makes me feel a little cold. You know, you should take an umbrella when you leave. Is that right?
Yes, I will take one. Oh, I also need some green onions for the soup. They are so good.
Of course, green onions go well with soup. You can buy them from the vegetable stand next to me. They are quite fresh today.
Thank you. I am going to cook a big meal for my family now.
That sounds wonderful. Honestly, a warm meal with family is the best thing in life. I hope your children enjoy the food.
I think they will. I will make sweet and sour fish for them.
Sweet and sour fish is delicious. Actually, many people here love that taste. Will you drink some jasmine tea after dinner?
Yes, we will drink tea. Thank you for your help with the fish.
You are very welcome. Well, I hope you have a happy evening at home. See you next time at the market.

messages.content: Hello Aunt Mei. I'm making tangyuan for the New Year's Eve dinner tonight.
Oh, really? That's wonderful. Well, I remember my mother used to make them every year in Hankou.
Yes, I want the red bean filling. How do I boil the water correctly?
You should bring the water to a boil first, then add the small balls carefully. By the way, they float when they are ready.
I see. Should I stir the soup before I serve it to my relatives?
Of course. Stir you know, stirring makes the soup look nicer. Also, you can add some ginger juice if you like.
Great. After we eat, are we going to watch the dragon dance performance?
Yes, that sounds fun. Actually, there will be a parade outside the community center nearby.
Perfect. Will we walk there or take the bus?
We're going to walk. The weather is not too cold tonight, so it will be nice.
Okay. I'm a bit tired though. Should I rest before the performance starts?

messages.content: Hi Li Wei. I'm Wei Ming from the coding team. I am so tired after my morning meeting.
Oh, really? MeetingsWell, meetings can be very long. I know a great place to eat near our office. It is right here in Haidian District.

That sounds delicious. Will it take long to wait for a table? I am worried about the time.
Well, it depends on the crowd. Actually, I can book us a small table right now. It's going to be faster.
Great idea. How do we go there? We can take the subway line 4 from our office building.
That is a good plan. The subway is much faster than the bus in autumn. It's not so hot or cold inside.
Yes, I agree. What time do we need to leave? We have twenty minutes for the lunch break.
We should leave now. It's better to go early so we can eat hot pot and come back on time. Don't be late!
Okay, I will get my bag. See you at the subway station entrance in five minutes.
Perfect. See you there! I hope you feel better after eating some good food.

Oh, really? That sounds fun. I like sports too, but I often read novels in the library. By the way, do you play badminton alone or with friends?

I did not read a book. I watched a movie about a singering music band. It is very interesting. Do you like music?

That is a good idea. I will bring some eggs for you. Can you play badminton next week? We can meet at the park.
That sounds fun. I am free on Saturday morning. I think we should meet at ten. I will bring my racket. See you soon!

messages.content: Hi Lin. I am playing badminton at the park in Chengdu today. It is sunny.
Oh, that is great! Well, I love playing sports too. I usually go to the Xindu Lake park on Sundays. Do you like the weather here?
Yes, I am very happy. The sun is warm. But my friend says the wind is strong sometimes. What do you do after badminton?
I see. That makes sense. After the game, I often drink some hot tea and buy some roasted chestnuts. They are very delicious. By the way, do you read novels?
Yes, I read a lot. I am reading a story about a young man in Beijing. He works hard at a university. Is it true that Beijing is big?
Of course, Beijing is the biggest city in China. Actually, I also read books about travel. Do you prefer historical books or science fiction stories? I think history is interesting.
I like historical books. I want to know about the past. But I am tired now. Maybe I will listen to music instead of reading. What kind of music do you like?
That is a good idea. You know, listening to music can help you relax. I often listen to pop songs by Chinese singers like Eason Chan. They are very talented. Are you planning to go home soon?
No, not yet. I am going to stay here for another hour. I want to talk to you more. Can we go to a restaurant later? I am hungry.
Sure! That sounds perfect. Actually, there is a famous hotpot restaurant near the park. We can eat spicy hotpot together. It is my favourite food. When are you free tomorrow?
Tomorrow is good for me. I will come at two o'clock. Thanks for your help, Lin. You are a good friend.
Thank you! I am happy to be your friend. See you at the restaurant tomorrow. Have a nice afternoon playing badminton now. Oh, don't forget to drink water!

messages.content: Hi Lin. It is very cold in Harbin today. I want to make dumplings at home.
Oh, really? I am so happy to hear that. Well, you know, I can teach you to make jiaozi.
That sounds great. But I do not know how to make the dough.
I see. It is easy. You need flour and water. Mix them well and knead the dough.
Okay. Will I roll the dough into small circles? How big should they be?
Yes, you are right. Make them about three centimeters wide. You know, mine are usually smaller.
I will fill them with pork and cabbage. Is that the best filling?
Of course! Pork and cabbage is my favourite too. It is very delicious and warm in winter.
Great. After we eat the dumplings, we will go to a hot pot restaurant.
That is a wonderful idea. By the way, there is a great place on Central Street.
Really? What kind of soup base do they have? I like spicy food.
They have a very spicy beef base. It is hotter than the regular one, I think.
Perfect. I will bring some fresh mushrooms and tofu. Do you have anything to add?
Yes, please bring some tripe and fish balls. They are fresh and very tasty with the hot soup.
Okay. I will buy them at the market near my building. See you later.
See you then! I will cook the dumplings first. It is going to be a fun lunch.

messages.content: Hi Brother, I'm coming back from work. It's so hot today in Kaifeng.
Oh, really? Well, the summer is very hot here. I think we should go to the lake soon to cool down.
That's a good idea. I'm tired from driving. Do you want to visit our grandparents after dinner?
Of course! My mum will be happy to see you. By the way, I bought some fresh noodles for her.
Great. I'll take my gifts to them. I have a new scarf for grandma.
Wow, that's nice. Grandma loves scarves. I think she will be very happy with your gift.
Yes. I'm going to make some dumplings for everyone. We can eat together.
Perfect. I'll help you chop the vegetables. It's always fun to cook with family.
Good. When will you start work tomorrow morning?
I'm starting at eight. I have to go to the office early. You know, I miss you a lot.
I understand. I'm not busy now, so I can stay longer with my parents.
That's wonderful. Let's go to the West Lake area now. The evening air is very fresh.

messages.content: Professor Zhang, I'm a bit worried about my thesis. It is getting hard.
Well, don't worry, Wei Lin. You're doing a great job on the local history. Actually, I think you should take a break now.
But I have to finish before the deadline. It is raining outside.
Oh, really? You know, the rain makes me feel cold too. By the way, have you taken notes on the new lecture yet?
Yes, I did. But I lost some pages of my notes. They were very important.
That is a problem. Well, you can print them again later. Actually, let's discuss your research first before we look for notes.
OK. So I am studying the old markets in Guangzhou. What do you think?
That is a good topic. You know, I remember visiting those places when I was young. They are quite different now.
Yes, many shops are closed. I feel a little sad about it.
I understand. Well, sad feelings are normal. But you should keep going with your work. After all, your thesis is very important.
Thank you, Professor. I will try to finish more today. Can I drink some tea?
Of course, go ahead. By the way, would you like some hot oolong tea? It's very good for a rainy day.
Yes, please. That sounds perfect. I am not thirsty at all.
Well, tea will make you feel better. I think we should stop now. You can go home before it gets too late.
OK, I will go now. Thanks for your help, Professor Zhang.

messages.content: Hello, Professor Zhang. It is raining outside Zhongshan University today.
Oh, really? I think the rain is getting heavier every hour. Well, let us start our meeting in the library.
I am sorry about your thesis. The topic on local history is very interesting.
Thank you. I have been working on it for three months. I need to organize my papers before the next lecture.
Can you help me with my notes? I do not understand some parts about the archives.
Of course. You know, taking notes in Chinese characters can be difficult sometimes. I will show you how I write them.
That sounds good. We are going to take a break after this discussion about history.
Great idea. By the way, would you like to drink some hot tea with ginger? It warms you up in the rain.
Yes, please. I am feeling a little cold. What time will the next class start?
The next class is at two o'clock. You must finish your notes before then. It is going to be busy.
I will try my best. Thank you for your advice, Professor Zhang.
You are welcome. Actually, your research is very important for our department. Let us drink the tea now.

Yes, I see it. But I do not know how to use it. It is a little busy.
Well, it is quite crowded tonight. Just tap your card and insert money.
Oh, really? I will tap my card. Which line should I take for Jinchuan Road?
You are going to the right way. Take line two, it goes directly to your sister's home.
Great! Is the train coming soon? I am a bit worried about the time.
Actually, the next train will arrive in two minutes. You can wait near the blue sign.
Okay, I will wait there. Thank you so much for your help, Li.
You are welcome. By the way, is it cold outside Chengdu today?
Yes, it is very cold. I am wearing a thick coat to stay warm.
I think you are dressed well. The winter in Chengdu is always very chilly.
I hope I do not miss the train. Should I go to the gate now?
Yes, please go now. I will stay here if you need any more help.

Hello! Well, the machine is right here. Do you have your card?
Yes, I have it. But I'm a bit worried about the lines.

Oh, I see. Where do I put my card?
It's here, actually. You put it in the slot like this. It's very simple.
Okay, I did it. It says one yuan. Is that right?
Yes, of course. That's a single trip ticket. You can keep it for now.
Great. When does the train to my sister's house come?
Wait a moment. The next train will arrive in about five minutes. It's going to go straight there.
Perfect. It's cold today, but I'm happy to go.
Yes, it's freezing outside. You should wear your warm coat. See you on the train!

messages.content: Hello Liu. I'm Hao Ming. I am a delivery driver. I'm very tired after work.
Oh, really? Delivery work is very hard, you know. Well, let's eat some fresh food here. It's warm tonight by the river.
Yes, the weather is nice. I want to buy some spicy skewers. Are they good?
Of course! My beef skewers are the best in Wuxi. I make them with special chili oil. You should try one right now.
That sounds delicious. I'll have two beef skewers. Do you sell green tea?
Yes, I have fresh jasmine tea. It's very cold and sweet. By the way, do you want to add some lemon?
Yes, please. I like the taste. How much is everything with lemon?
It's thirty yuan total. That's a good price for tonight. Here, take my hand and see the menu.
Thank you. I only have cash. Do you accept WeChat payment?
Actually, I need cash tonight because my phone is low. Please give me RMB. I will count it carefully for you.
Okay, I give you thirty yuan. Here is the money.
Thank you, Hao Ming. Here are your skewers and tea. They are hot, so be careful. Enjoy your dinner!
Thanks, Liu. I will eat fast. Good night!

Oh, hello Hao Ming! Come here. Well, we have many skewers. You know, the spicy ones are very hot!
Yes, I like spicy food. I will eat three chicken skewers. They look good.
That sounds right. I will give them to you now. By the way, do you want a cold drink?
Oh, yes. I am thirsty. Can I have a can of cola tea? It is cold.
Of course. Here is a can of Jiaozui tea. It's very cold and sweet. You like it?
Yes, I like it. But I do not have my wallet. I will use my phone to pay.
Oh, really? That is okay. You can scan the code on the table. I accept mobile payments.
Great. I am paying now. It is forty yuan. Is this the right price?
Yes, that is correct. Well, here are your skewers and the tea. Enjoy your meal!
Thank you Liu. This is delicious. I am going to eat it quickly.
I'm happy to hear that. By the way, come back next Friday if you want more food.

Actually, no! Drink the herbal tea I made for you. It's very warm and good for you.
Okay, I will drink it before I sleep tonight.

It is very cold in Suzhou this Sunday morning.
I see. The weather is really bad. You must stay inside until you feel better.

messages.content: Hi Lin Yue, it is Saturday. I am playing badminton in the park today.
Oh, really? That is great! Well, I love sports too. By the way, where is the park?

I am going home. I will cook dinner for my family. It is my hobby.
Wow, that sounds delicious! Actually, I can cook too. Do you make dumplings?
Yes! I make sweet and sour pork. It is my favourite dish.

That is nice. But I am hungry now. I will eat first.

messages.content: Hi Lin Mei, how was your weekend in Wuhou district?
It was great! I went to the park near Chunxi Road. By the way, did you play badminton this Saturday?
Yes, I played badminton with my friends in the morning. It was fun!
That sounds amazing. I actually prefer table tennis. It is a bit faster and more exciting.
Oh, really? Do you have a table tennis bat your neighborhood?
Well, yes, there is a small court near my building. I go there every day after work. It's not far from here.
I see. I like eating food after sports. Did you cook anything special?
Yes, I made dumplings with my family. They were delicious. We used pork and cabbage for the filling.
Pork and cabbage? That is my favourite too. Can I try your recipe next time?
Of course! I think you can come over on Sunday afternoon. We will make some more dumplings together.
Great idea! What time should I arrive at your house?
Around two in the afternoon would be perfect. You know, my mum will be home and happy to see you.

That sounds fun. How far is it to the Broken Rock?
It is about ten minutes walk. I will buy you some hot tea when we get there.
Thank you. Tea is good for me. I am feeling a little tired today.

Good idea. Maybe I can eat some fresh flowers after the walk.
Haha, you are joking crazy! No, you cannot eat flowers. But we can drink lotus seed soup.
Ah, I see. Soup is better than flowers. I am ready to go now.
Perfect. Then we will start our walk to Broken Rock right now.

I love hot pot. Can I help with cleaning up after the show?

I am a bit worried about the cold weather. It is very winter right now.
I see. Well, many people bring warm coats. It is cold, but the firecrackers make it warm.
Okay, I will bring a jacket. When should I meet the group?
Meet meet at the main gate at nine. We will check your ticket before you enter.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhang Jun. Do you know about the festival in Pudong?
Yes, I know! It's going to be a big celebration. Well, there will be many lanterns and food stalls.
That sounds nice. Can I join the volunteer work?
Of course! You can help at the street market near Lujiazui. It's very busy this year.
Oh, really? When do the classes for volunteers start?
They start next Monday. You know, we will need people before the main show.
Great. I am free on Monday morning. What time should I arrive?
You should come at nine. By the way, bring some warm clothes because it's cold.
Good idea. Will there be Chinese food like jiaozi?
Yes, lots of dumplings! I think you will love them. They are the best here.
I am happy to eat them. Is there a subway line nearby?
Yes, Line 2 stops right at the gate. It's easy to get there.
Perfect. Thank you for telling me about this event.
No problem! I will see you next week. Have a nice day, Zhang Jun.

messages.content: Hello. I'm Liu Fang. It is very hot tonight in Chongqing.
Yes, the weather is terrible. By the way, I'm selling spicy hotpot and noodles. Would you like some?
Oh, really? I love noodles. Can I have a bowl of spicy beef noodles?
Of course! Well, the beef is very fresh. You know, it's hotter than yesterday's noodles. How much spicy sauce do you want?
I think I want a little bit. I am not very hungry.
That's fine. Actually, the sauce is very good. I mean, many people add more when they are eating. What would you like to drink?
Maybe some cold tea? Is it cold in the shop?
Yes! The tea is ice cold. By the way, I have green tea and jasmine tea. Which one do you prefer?
I prefer green tea. It is healthier than jasmine tea.
I see. Well, the green tea is very nice. You know, it helps you sleep better at night. How much money do you have?
I have twenty yuan. Is that enough for two bowls of noodles?
Yes, it's enough. Actually, one bowl is only fifteen yuan. I'll give you a free dumpling. Do you want to try it?
Oh, that is great! I will try the dumpling. Thank you.

messages.content: Hello! I'm so tired. I just finished work at the factory. I'm hungry now.
Oh, I see! Well, come here and sit down. It's late at night, but my stall is still open. You know, I make some great spicy hotpot for workers like you.
Spicy hotpot? I love spicy food! Can I add some beef noodles? They are my favourite.
Of course! By the way, our beef noodles are very fresh tonight. Would you also like some jiaozi? They are small dumplings with pork inside.
Yes, please give me the jiaozi. I haven't eaten dumplings for two days. They taste amazing.
Great choice! Actually, we use special sauce for them. It's a little hot, but it's delicious. I make it with chili oil and garlic. You know, many people love it.
Wow, that sounds hot. I can't eat very spicy food today. My stomach hurts a bit.
I understand. Well, I can make it mild for you. Just tell me how spicy you want. Oh, and drink some cold lemon tea. It's very refreshing in this summer heat.
That is a good idea. I will drink the lemon tea. Thank you for helping me.
You're welcome! By the way, this street near Jiefangbei is always busy at midnight. Many people like to eat here. Do you come here often after work?
Yes, I come every Friday. It is better than eating at home alone. The food here is better too.
Really? I think so too! Well, I'll bring extra dumplings for you. They are the best in Chongqing. You know, I make them every night.
Perfect. I am so happy now. I will pay you with twenty yuan. Is that enough?
No, it's fine. You're so kind. Actually, you can keep the change. Enjoy your meal! See you next Friday, maybe?

messages.content: Hi Lin. I'm so tired today. My boss made me stay late at the office in Nanshan.
Oh, really? I'm sorry to hear that. Well, sometimes work is very busy. Did you finish your report yet?
Yes, I finished it. But I have to take the subway now. It is very crowded.
I see. The Line 1 is busy after five o'clock. You know, you should leave a little earlier next time.
I can't. The traffic is bad. I will take a taxi. It is expensive though.
That's true. A taxi is fast, but it costs more money. Actually, I take the metro most days.
What time do you usually leave your company? Is it early?
I leave at five. It is not early, but it is better than staying late. You're lucky today.
I will drink some coffee now. It helps me feel a bit better.
Good idea. By the way, do you like Chinese tea? It is good for tired people too.
I like green tea. My aunt brings it sometimes. It tastes very fresh.
Oh, that sounds nice. Green tea is healthier than coffee. You should try drinking it tomorrow.
Okay, I will. I am going home now. I must go.
Take care on the way. I hope the weather is nice when you get home.

Oh, really? Well, I understand you are tired. By the way, we usually finish work at six in the evening.
But the boss says the deadline is tomorrow morning. I have to stay late again.
That sounds tough. I think the deadline is too tight this week. Have you eaten anything yet?
No, I did not eat lunch because I was too busy. I only drank some coffee.
You should eat something now. Let me go buy you some jianbing for breakfast. It is hot and delicious.
That is very kind of you. I will take a break after I eat the jianbing.
Good idea. Actually, I have to catch the metro line 1 to go home after work.
Which station do you take? I live near Huaqiangbei station in Nanshan District.
Oh, you live near Huaqiangbei? That is convenient. I will take line 1 to Shenzhen Bay Station.
Okay, I will stay here for one hour. Then I will go home with you.
Perfect. Well, let us go to the canteen now before we continue working. It is almost five o'clock.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Li Xiang. I am going to visit my grandparents in Chengdu this weekend.
That sounds wonderful, Li Xiang! Well, I have been to Chengdu twice. It is a very fun city.
Yes, I know. How will I get to the countryside from Qingyang Station?
You should take the high-speed train. By the way, the trains are fast and very cheap.
Oh, really? When will the next train leave?
The next train will leave at nine o'clock. You can buy a ticket online now.
Great. What food will my grandparents make for us?
They will probably cook Mapo Tofu. It is spicy and delicious. You know, I love that dish.
I love Mapo Tofu too. Do I need to book a hotel first?
No, your grandparents have a house. You do not need a hotel. It is more comfortable.
That is good. I am a little worried about the cold weather.
Don't worry, the weather is actually quite mild right now. You should bring a warm jacket though.
Okay, I will bring a coat. Thank you for your advice.
You are welcome! I hope you have a great trip to see your family soon.

messages.content: Hello. I am Li Xiang. I will visit my grandparents in Leshan this weekend.
Hi Li Xiang! That sounds like a nice trip. Well, did you book a high-speed train ticket already?
Yes, I have a ticket. I will leave from Qingyang Station at nine o'clock.
Great! By the way, is the train faster than the old trains? I think it is very fast.
Yes, it is much faster. I can eat breakfast before I get there.
Oh, really? I love eating breakfast. What kind of food do you like to eat there?
I will eat dan dan noodles and mapo tofu. My grandpa cooks very well.
Wow, those are famous foods! I think I should try them too. How old is your grandpa?
He is seventy years old. He lives in a small town near Leshan.
Seventy is not old at all. He must be very strong. Do you have any cousins there?
Yes, I have two cousins. We will visit them after lunch at the train station.
That is a good plan. You know, the weather is sunny today. It will be great for walking.
I am happy about the weather. I hope the train is on time.
Don't worry. High-speed trains are usually very punctual. Enjoy your time with your family!

Oh, really? I think you need a warm coat. Do you like our down jackets?

It is three thousand yuan. By the way, do you have a membership card?
No, I don't have one. But I am a student at Tsinghua University.
Oh, that is great! Students can get a discount. Let me check the system for you.
Okay, please. I will try it on if it is not too expensive.
I see. The price is only two thousand five hundred yuan with your student card.
Wow, that is cheaper. I will buy this one. Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Here is the receipt. We hope to see you in the mall again soon.

Good idea. See you at Qingyang Riverside Park tomorrow morning!

messages.content: Hi, Ms. Li. I am Chen Hao. I work in an office nearby. Are you organizing a community event this Sunday?
Hello, Chen Hao! Yes, we are. We are cleaning the streets in Gulou District. Actually, it's very important for our neighborhood.
Oh, really? I think cleaning is hard work. Will we use plastic bags for the trash?
Well, yes. We will use blue and green bags. You know, we separate the waste carefully. Do you have any experience with this?
No, I do not. But I can help. Are there other activities besides cleaning the street?
Of course! We are also planting new trees along the road. It's going to be nice when the flowers grow. Would you like to join?
That sounds fun. I love nature. When should we arrive at the park gate?
We will meet at ten o'clock in the morning. Please bring a bottle of water. It's quite hot this summer in Nanjing.
I see. I have some tea at home. Can I bring that instead? It is very refreshing.
That's a great idea! Green tea is perfect for the heat. By the way, do you have gloves? You need them for digging.
I have a pair at my desk. I will take them with me. What should I wear for the work today?
Comfortable shoes are best, Chen Hao. You will be walking a lot. Also, a hat is useful for the sun.
Perfect. Thank you for inviting me. I am happy to help my community.
I'm so glad you joined us! Everyone's help makes a big difference. See you this Sunday at the park.

messages.content: Hi, Mr. Wang. I am Zhang Li. I come from Beijing, but I live in Xi'an now.
Hello, Li! Welcome to my shop. Well, it is very cold outside today, so many people come here for hot food.
Yes, I am hungry. I will order some jiaozi with pork and cabbage. They are my favourite.
Of course. I will cook them for you now. You know, these jiaozi are better than the ones in Beijing, don't you think?
I think so. Please make them spicy. I like spicy food very much.
No problem. I will add hot oil and chili powder. By the way, would you like a cup of soy milk with your meal?
Yes, please. It is good for my stomach in winter. How much is the soy milk?
It is only five yuan. Actually, it is very cheap and healthy. Many students buy it after school.
That is a good price. I will take two cups. Can I pay with my phone?
Sure, you can use WeChat or Alipay. Well, your friends are coming soon, right? They will be happy to see these dumplings.
Yes, they are here. We are going to eat quickly because we have to go home early.
Okay. I will bring the food fast. Oh, right, please wait a minute while I pour the hot tea for everyone.
Thank you. The tea smells good. I hope we can come back next week.

messages.content: Hello Uncle Zhang! I am Liu Fang, your daughter's teacher. I am so happy to visit you in Chongqing.
Oh, Fang! It's great to see you. Well, you know, the weather in Yubei is a little cold tonight, but the fire is warm.
I love the winter here. We are making mooncakes for the festival. Should I add some egg yolk inside?
Yes, of course! My grandma always says you must put a yolk in the center. Actually, it makes the taste much better.
That sounds delicious. By the way, will you teach me how to send a red envelope later?
I'll show you right now. You know, in my village, elders give money to young people for good luck. It's a special tradition.
Oh, I see. I will learn the words on the red paper first. What should I write there?
Well, you should write 'Happy New Year' and 'Best Wishes'. Oh, and don't forget to put the money inside the paper carefully.
Got it. Later, we are going to watch the dragon dance in the square. It looks very exciting.
It is! The dragon moves very fast. I think the children play the drums. You know, the noise is very loud and fun.
Yes, I love the drums. Can we take photos with our phones? I want to send them to my students.
Sure! You can take photos. Honestly, your students will be happy to see the real dragon. It's much better than TV.
Thank you, Uncle Zhang. I am tired now, but I feel very lucky to be with you.
You are welcome, Fang. I'm glad you are here. We will rest now and watch the fireworks later tonight.

messages.content: Hello Grandpa Chen. I am so happy to see you here in Yubei District today.
I'm very happy too, Fang. It is good to have you back in our village. By the way, how was your trip from Chongqing?
It was tiring, but the train was fast. I am going to make mooncakes now.
Oh, really? Well, mooncakes are the best food for the festival. You know, my grandma always made them with five kinds of nuts.
That sounds delicious. Can I help you mix the ingredients? I have some dates.
Of course! Yes, you can help. Actually, we need more red beans too. It is important to share the work.
I understand. After we finish, we can watch the dragon dance outside.
That is a great idea. The dragon dance is very exciting. You know, the kids in the square will join the performance soon.
Wow, I will take lots of photos. My parents sent me a red envelope last week.
Oh, that is wonderful. You should give it to your children later. Well, I have to go check the firework setup now.
Okay, Grandpa. See you later. I am going to wash the fruit first.
Sure thing. See you in a bit. I hope you enjoy the fireworks tonight.

Hello, Xiao Ya! Well, you can take Line 1 subway to get there. It is very fast.

Actually, Line 1 goes to West Lake first, and then to other places later. You are safe here.
Great! I will go and buy a ticket with my 10 yuan.

Is the price cheaper than the tea in the supermarket?

Oh, really? I should try this tea before I go home.
Good idea! By the way, do you like tea in a tin or a paper bag?
I prefer the tin because the air cannot get in. Can I have a tin please?
Sure. Here's a nice tin for you. You should drink it after work, it's relaxing.

messages.content: Hello. I feel very tired today. I need to go to City Central Hospital in Chengdu.
Oh, I see. It's so hot in Chengdu this morning, you know. That makes people feel tired. Welcome to the waiting room.
Thank you. My name is Liu Hua. Do I need to show my ID card first?
Yes, of course. You must show your ID card at the desk. By the way, please fill out this form first.
Okay. Is the waiting room very big or small here?
It is quite big. There are many chairs and fans for the summer. You can sit there and wait for your number.
I see. When will the doctor come for my checkup?
Well, I think it will take about twenty minutes. The doctor will call your name soon. Please do not be worried.
That is good. I also want to check my blood pressure.
Of course, we can check your blood pressure right now. It is very important for your health. Would you like some water while you wait?
Yes, please. I am a little nervous about the test.
Don't worry, I mean it's just a simple test. You will feel fine after we finish. Here is some cool water for you.
Thank you very much. I am happy now.
That's great. I'll call you when the doctor is ready. Take a deep breath and relax.

messages.content: Hi Mr. Wang, I'm renovating my old apartment in Ritan Community. It's going to be hard work.
Oh, that's a big project, Zhao Jing. Well, I helped my sister fix her kitchen last year.
Really? What did you do for the kitchen? I need new cabinetsting furniture too.
We bought simple wooden cabinetsting from a local market. It's not too expensive and looks nice.
Good idea. But my walls are dirty. Should I paint them before I move the furniture?
Yes, you must paint first. Actually, I like white walls because they look very clean and bright.
I agree. Whiteting paint is easy, but I don't know which color to choose for the bedroom.
Blue or light green is very popular here. By the way, did you buy the paint yet?
No, I haven't. I will go to the hardware store tomorrow after work. It's a bit far though.
That's okay, take the bus. I think it's faster than walking. You can buy it from any big shop.
Thanks for the advice. I'm a little worried about the cost. Renovation is very costly in China.
Don't worry too much. You can save money if you buy used furniture. It's still very useful.
That makes sense. I'm going to ask my cousin for help next week. She knows about this.

messages.content: Hi Wang. I'm painting my new kitchen today. It's getting messy.
Oh, really? That's a big job. Well, paint gets everywhere. Do you have a ladder?
Yes, I have one. But I can't reach the top. I'm worried.
I see. You should ask a friend for help. My cousin is coming over later.
That's good. When will he arrive? Is he coming by bike?
He'll arrive at two o'clock. He is coming by bus, not bike. The road is nice.
Oh, I know. I like the bus. It's free sometimes. By the way, do you have furniture?
Yes, we bought a table last week. It's very simple. Where did you buy yours?
I bought it in a shop near my house. The price was low. I'm happy.
That's great. You know, a good price is important. I'll bring some tea when I see you.
Thank you. I will finish the painting after he arrives. See you soon.

Oh, that sounds fun! Well, the weather is nice today, you know. Will you bring your son?

Wow, a Golden Retriever! Well, I want to see your dog sometime. Are you free next week?
Yes, I am free on Saturday. We can walk together after the park.
Perfect! That sounds like a good plan. I'm looking forward to it.

messages.content: Hi Zhang Wei. I'm Xiao Lan from Kunming University. I'm very excited to hike here today in Lijiang Ancient Town.
Hello Xiao Lan! I'm so happy to meet you. Well, the weather is perfect for walking. It's sunny and a bit cool.
Yes, it is nice. Are we climbing the hill near the old bridge now? It looks very beautiful.
That's right. We're going up the path slowly. Actually, I think you can see many wild flowers there. They are red and white.
Wow, I love flowers. Can we stop and drink some tea when we reach the top? I feel a little tired now.
Of course, we can stop anytime. By the way, my grandmother makes the best hot tea. It will warm you up quickly after the walk.
That sounds great. I'm not good at hiking hills. But I want to try it. Is the path difficult?
Don't worry. The path is easy for beginners. You know, most people start here in spring. It's not too steep.
Okay, I'm ready. Let's go. What should I bring for the hike? Do I need a map?
You're doing great. Actually, I have a small map. We also need water. Oh, and maybe a snack like rice cakes.
Great idea. I'll drink the tea soon. I'm really enjoying this trip with you.
Me too. It's fun to see the mountains. When we get back, we can eat some dumplings at a restaurant nearby.
Yes! That sounds delicious. Thank you for guiding me, Zhang Wei.

I love flowers. Are they red or yellow this season?
Actually, there are many red azaleas. They are very pretty compared to the green trees.
That is nice. What time should we start the hike?
Well, let's go at nine o'clock. It is not too hot yet in the morning.
Okay. Do I need to bring warm clothes?
Yes, you should wear a jacket. It gets a little cold when the wind blows on the mountain.
I have a warm coat. Will we drink hot tea after the hike?
That is a good idea! We will drink some hot jasmine tea at the small shop. It helps you relax.
I am happy about the tea. When do we meet at the gate?
We meet at the gate at nine sharp. I will wait for you there. See you soon, Xiao Lan!

messages.content: Hi Sun Yue! I am cooking for the New Year's Eve dinner tonight.
Oh, really? That is so nice of you, Zhao Xin. Well, the kitchen must be very busy right now.

Wow, your dinner will be delicious. I hope your family is happy and they enjoy the food you cook.

Osmanthus tea is perfect for January in Harbin. It is so warm and sweet for the cold weather.
Yes, it is very special. My husband will help me serve the food.
I see. Your husband must be happy to help you. I am coming over tomorrow to try your cooking.
That is great! You can come to my house in the afternoon.
Okay, I will be there at two o'clock. I am very excited to meet your family soon.

messages.content: Hello Zhang Lan. I am starting a new job today in Tianhe. Can you tell me about the bus?
Hi Wei Ming, well I am very happy for you. Of course, you can take the number 10 bus. It goes to my office building.
Oh really? When does the first bus come? I do not want to be late.
I think the first one arrives at seven thirty. By the way, you should buy a metro card if you do not have one.
Yes I need that. Where can I buy the card before I go?
Well there is a shop near your apartment. You can also buy it at the station entrance. It is very convenient.
Good. Who are the other people in my office?
Actually you will meet Li Qiang tomorrow. He is the manager. Also, Chen Xiao works there with him. They are very nice people.
I hope they are friendly. What time does work start?
Work starts at nine sharp. You must be there before nine thirty. I am usually there at eight forty-five.
I will be there on time. Do I need any office supplies?
The company gives you a notebook and a pen. You do not need to buy anything yet. Oh, and you should wear comfortable shoes.
Thank you for your help. I feel less worried now.
You are welcome. I will show you the way later. We can go together if you like. Good luck today!

messages.content: Hello Zhang Lan. I am Wei Ming. This is my first day at the office.
Oh, really? Welcome, Wei Ming. I think you will like it here. By the way, how are you feeling?
I am a little worried. I do not know how to get to the building. Where is the bus stop?
Well, the stop is near Haizhu Square. You take the No. 4 bus to Tianhe Road. It is very easy.
The No. 4 bus? Okay. Do I need to change buses? I have only one yuan left.
You can go straight, I mean, no change needed. Actually, you should buy a card. The bus is cheap, you know.
Okay, I will buy a card. When is the first bus? I do not want to be late.
The first bus leaves at six thirty. You must be there before seven. It is very busy in the morning.
I see. My boss is Lin Fang. She is very kind. Do you know her?
Yes, of course! She is my colleague. You will meet her after the meeting. She is very nice.
That is good. Do I need to bring my own stap supplies? I have no pens yet.
Oh, actually, the company gives you stationery. You do not need to buy anything. There's a box in your desk.
Wow, thank you! I am so happy. I can relax now. Is there any food nearby?
There is a small shop near the gate. They sell baozi and soy milk. You can eat there before work.
Perfect. I will eat baozi. Thank you Zhang Lan for your help today.
You are welcome, Wei Ming. I hope you have a great day. See you at the office later!

Oh, I'm sorry to hear that, Qiang. Well, how long have you had this pain?

How many times a day should I take them? I don't want to miss.

messages.content: Hello, nurse Liu Mei. My name is Zhao Qiang. I have a bad headache today.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that, Zhao Qiang. Well, when did the headache start, you know?
It started this morning. I was working in the factory and it was very cold.
That makes sense. It's very cold in Wuxi during winter, actually. Do you have a fever too?
Yes, I think so. My temperature is a little high. Maybe thirty-eight degrees?
Oh, really? That is quite high. I will take your temperature again to be sure.
Okay, thank you. It feels hot now. I feel very tired and weak.
I see. You should rest for at least two days. You must drink plenty of water, too.
Okay. What medicine should I take? I need some for the headache and the fever.
Well, I will give you some Panadol and some cough syrup. You should take them after meals.
Is the medicine expensive? I only have a few yuan left in my wallet.
Don't worry, the medicine is not expensive at all. Here's your prescription, it's very cheap.
Great. Will I feel better tomorrow if I rest at home?
Yes, I think so. You should stay warm and drink hot tea when you come home.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin Xiao. I love nature walks.
Hello, Lin Xiao! Oh, that's great. I'm a tour guide here. By the way, the autumn air is so cool today.
Yes, it is. Do you know the best walking trail near the lake?
Sure! You should go up the path to the old pine trees. It's not too hard, you know. The view is amazing there.
Wow, the view? I want to see the clouds.
Of course, you can see many clouds up there. Actually, I think they look like white sheep sheep sheep cotton balls. You must have a good camera.
Yes, I have one. But I also want to drink water from the stream.
Oh, really? That's a good idea. You can drink the mountain spring water. It's very fresh, I promise. Well, just drink a little bit.
Okay. Should I bring my own tea?
No, you don't need to. I have some fresh green tea. We can sit by the water and drink it. It tastes better with the leaves.
That sounds perfect. When should we start walking?
We can start now, right now. The sun is still high. Don't worry about being late. Let's go together!
Great. I'm a little tired, but I'm happy to walk.
I see. Take your time, Lin Xiao. Rest if you need to. The path is safe for everyone. We will stop for tea soon.

messages.content: Hi, Mr. Wang. It is cold outside in Xi'an tonight, isn't it?
Yes, I think so. The wind is strong near the Bell Tower. By the way, would you like some warm tea?
Oh, yes please! I am so tired from work at the shop.
I see. You must be very tired after selling clothes all day. We should drink some ginger tea to feel better.
That sounds good. I will eat hot pot with my old friends tomorrow.
Oh, really? That is great! I love hot pot too. You know, the broth is very spicy and hot.
Yes, I will have lamb and tofu in the soup. Do you make dumplings here?
Of course! We make fresh dumplings every evening. They are better than any restaurant in the city.
They sound delicious. I am hungry now. Can I have one please?
Sure, here you go. I'll put pork and cabbage inside for you. It is my favourite filling.
Thank you, Mr. Wang. This is very hot and tasty.
I am glad you like it. Would you like some vinegar for the dumplings? It is very common here.
Yes, please. I will put it on the table before I eat more.
Right. By the way, are your friends coming to eat with you tomorrow night?
Yes, they will come. We will go to a small restaurant near my house.

That is a great idea. By the way, the weather here is a bit cold today.
I know. But the celebration is warm inside the hall. Thank you for coming.
You are welcome! I am glad we can celebrate together with your family today.

messages.content: Hello, I am Lin Jing. I want to go to Guilin today.
Hi, Lin Jing! Of course, the high-speed rail is very fast. It takes only two hours.
Oh, that is quick. I will buy a ticket now. How much is it?
Well, the ticket costs three hundred yuan. You can pay with WeChat or cash.
I have cash. I will pay you. Where is the train from?
It leaves from the Guilin North Station. By the way, the scenery is amazing when you go.
Yes, I saw photos of the Li River. It is very beautiful.
Actually, you will see the limestone mountains too. They are tall and green.
Great. I am going to stay there for three days.
That is perfect. You can ride the bamboo raft boat on the water.
Do I need a reservation for the boat? I do not know.
Yes, you should book it before you go. It is very popular in the morning.
Okay, I will book it now. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Have a nice trip, Lin Jing. I think you will love it.

messages.content: Hello. I am Lin Jing. I am going to Guilin for the summer holiday.
Hello, Lin Jing. Oh, really? That sounds wonderful. Guilin has very beautiful mountains.
Yes, I love the Li River. How do I get there? Do I take a bus?
Well, actually, you can take the high-speed train. It is very fast and comfortable.
Great. When is the next train to Guilin from Beijing? I need to go now.
By the way, the next train leaves at ten in the morning. It arrives in three hours.
Perfect. How much is the ticket? I only have two hundred yuan.
The ticket is two hundred and fifty yuan. You should buy it now because it is busy.
Oh, I see. Can I pay with WeChat? I do not have enough cash.
Of course, you can pay with WeChat or Alipay. It is very convenient for everyone.
Thank you. Where is the platform? I am worried I will miss the train.
The platform is number five. Please go there before the train leaves at ten.
I will go there now. I am so happy to see my family again.
I'm so glad to hear that. Enjoy your trip on the Li River, Lin Jing!

messages.content: Hello doctor. My name is Liu Fang. I have a sore back.
Hello, Mrs. Liu. I'm Dr. Wang from this clinic. When did your pain start?
It started yesterday. I walked too much in the old market.
Oh, really? That's why you feel stiff. Did you sit down after walking?
No, I kept walking. Now my back hurts a lot. It is very bad.
Well, I see. You should rest more. Please sit on this warm chair now.
Thank you. I am tired. Can I have some medicine for my pain?
Of course. I will give you some painkillers and some herbal tea.
How many times a day? Should I take it before or after meals?
You should take it after meals, three times a day for three days.
Okay. I will drink the tea. By the way, is the tea hot?
Yes, it is hot and good for your stomach. You know, rest your back.
I will go home now. Thank you, doctor. My back feels better.

messages.content: Hello doctor. I have a bad back pain today.

Thank you doctor. I will go home now.
You're welcome. Bye, Liu Fang. Take care of yourself.

messages.content: Hi Lin, it's a hot day here in Chengdu. I want to go to Wuhou park.
Oh, really? Yes, it is very sunny! By the way, I'm playing badminton there now.
That sounds fun. Can I join you? I have my racket in my bag.
Sure, Lin Wei! Of course, you can play with me. But wait, I need my water bottle first.
I will bring some sweet soy milk for you. Is that okay?
Yes, that's great. I love sweet soy milk. Well, let's meet at the big gate in five minutes.
Okay. When we play, should we buy drinks later or now?
I think we should buy them now because it is hot. Anyway, I will buy some bingfen too.
Good idea. After we play badminton, do you want to take photos?
Yes! I like taking photos of the willow trees. Actually, my photos are very good this year.
Really? Can you show me your phone? I will take a picture of the lake.
Sure, look at this one. It's from last week. Oh, here comes my friend, he is running fast.
He is so fast. Let's play for one more hour and then eat lunch.

Hi, Tao! I'm so happy to see you today. It is raining outside, but the community needs help.
Oh, really? I am here to clean the streets on Pingjiang Road.

I can do that. My friends and I always help on weekends.
You know, it is very kind of you. Many young people do not join us because of the rain.
I do not mind. Helping can we also visit the elderly people in the building next door?
Of course! Actually, Mrs. Liu lives there. She is very old and she cannot walk far.
I will buy some dumplings for her later. Is that a good idea?
Yes, it is perfect. She loves jiaozi very much. By the way, should we bring warm jackets too?
Good idea. I have a blue jacket. It is warmer than my red one.
Excellent! Let us start now. We must finish before the bus leaves the station.
Okay. I am ready. Where should we put the dirty bags first?
Right, put them by the main gate. I think we are going to have a busy morning today.

messages.content: Hello! I am Liu Yan. I love cooking traditional food in Kunming.
Hello, Yan! I am Chef Wang from a small restaurant. I think you should try making moon dumplings.
Oh, really? How do I cook them? It is hard for me sometimes.
Well, you just need fresh skin and filling. You know, put the skin in your hand first.
I see. What kind of filling is best in Dianchi Lake area?
Actually, we use pork and mushrooms. It is delicious and very popular here in winter.
That sounds good. But I am also drinking tea. Which tea do you like?
I love Yunnan Pu'er tea. It is strong and warm. You should drink it after eating dumplings.
I have never tried Pu'er tea before. Is it expensive to buy?
Not too expensive. You can buy a small box. It is much cheaper than coffee for me.
Great idea! I will go to the market tomorrow. Thank you for the tip.
You are welcome! By the way, have you tried sharing dishes with your family yet?
Yes, we share everything. My husband likes the soup more than the dumplings.
Haha, that is normal. Soup is very important for us in Kunming. It keeps you warm at night.

You are welcome! I hope you enjoy cooking. See you next time in the restaurant.
