messages.content: Hello. I am Lin. I am going to Guilin by train.
Oh, really? That is a wonderful idea. By the way, have you bought your ticket yet?
No, I haven't. I am standing in front of the window now.
I see. Well, the line is quite long today, so please be patient. You know, I waited for an hour once.
Oh no. I am worried. The station is very busy in the morning.
Don't worry. It is normal in Chengdu, especially in spring. You just need to show your ID card.
Yes, I have my ID card in my pocket. Is it a special card?
Of course, it is your Chinese ID card. Actually, you can also use your mobile phone now for the ticket.
Really? My phone battery is low. I think I need to buy a paper ticket.
That is fine. But please, hurry up because the train leaves in twenty minutes.
Okay. Where is the ticket counter? It is near the gate, right?
Yes, you are right. The counter is right there. Actually, you should take the yellow bus to get there.
I see. Thank you for your help. I am going to the counter now.
You are welcome. Just remember to take your train map when you go to Guilin. Have a nice trip!

messages.content: Hi! I am Hua from Beijing. This market in Su zhou is very busy today.
Hello, Hua! Well, it is a sunny afternoon here, so many people are shopping.
I want to buy some green tea. It is better than the tea I drink in Beijing.
Of course! This Longjing tea is very famous. It is the best in Su zhou.
How much is it? I only have one hundred yuan. Can I buy a small bag?
It is eighty yuan for a big bag, but I can give it to you for sixty.
Sixty is okay, but I want to bargain a little more. Is fifty yuan enough?
Oh, fifty is a little low. But well, I will sell it to you for fifty-five.
Great! I will take the tea now. Also, I need a silk scarf for my mom.
By the way, our silk is very soft. This one is red and very pretty.
Yes, it is nice. How much is the scarf? I want to pack my bags soon.
It is forty yuan. If you buy the tea and the scarf, I can give you a free bag.
That is a good deal! I am going to buy both. Thank you very much.
You are welcome! You can take your things home safely now. Enjoy your trip!

Hi Hua! Welcome to Suzhou. By the way, this tea is very famous here.
Yes, I know. Is it good for health? I want to buy some.

Oh really? Can we make it twenty-five yuan? Please.

It is perfect! How much for the scarf and the tea?
The scarf is fifty yuan and the tea is twenty-five. That is seventy-five yuan in total.
I have eighty yuan. Can I pay now? I will go to the bus station soon.
Yes, please. Here is your change. You can take the bus to Beijing safely.
Thank you very much! I am going to check the bus time now.

messages.content: Hello, Wang. It's a beautiful morning in Hangzhou today.
Yes, I agree! The mist over the West Lake looks amazing. I'm going to walk in the forest trail soon.
That sounds fun. Do you like the pine trees there?

I see. Can we see any birds while we walk?

Great. When should we start walking, before or after breakfast?
After should walk after breakfast. I think it's better for our health to have some food first.
Good idea. Will you bring a warm coat with you?
Yes, I will. It's a bit cool in the morning. I'm wearing my blue jacket today.
Perfect. I'm happy to walk with you this weekend.
That is wonderful! Well, see you at the gate then. The fresh air will feel great.

messages.content: Hi Wang. It is very cold this morning in Hangzhou.
Hello, Li. I am so glad you are out here. It is quite misty, isn't it?
Yes, I see the mountains clearly. I love the fresh air.
Well, the air here is the best in autumn. Do you see any birds?
Oh, really? I hear a small bird singing tree near the path.
That is wonderful. By the way, I saw a magpie flying just now.
A magpie? It is very beautiful. We should walk more slowly.
I think that is a good idea. You know, the path is a little slippery.
Okay. I will wear my warm sweater. It is much better than yesterday.
Of course. Tomorrow, we can go to the West Lake if you want.
That sounds nice. We will drink hot tea after the walk.
Perfect! Green tea from Longjing village is my favourite. See you soon.

messages.content: Hi, Teacher Wang. I am Xiao. I am so excited about tonight in Guiyang.
Oh, really? Well, the dragon dance here is the best in Guizhou province.
Yes, I have to watch it. Where is the dragon coming from?

Wow, it is longer than the one in Beijing. I will go there soon.
That is great. By the way, we also have many lanterns in the square now.
Oh, I love lanterns. Can I buy a small one for my sister?
Of course. You can buy them near the bus station. They are very cheap.
Perfect. I am worried about the crowd, though. It is too busy.
I think so too. But don't worry, the police will help us find a place.
Okay, I have to wait for the bus then. I am hungry, by the way.
Well, let's eat some hotpot first. It is the most delicious food in Guiyang.
That sounds perfect. I will eat the spicy beef with you.
Great idea. We can go to the restaurant after the dragon dance starts.

I'm so glad to hear that. Take a rest now and enjoy the festival later. You will have a wonderful time tonight!

messages.content: Hello. I am Hua. It is raining outside in Kunming today.
Oh, it is typical for Kunming in spring. Well, come in and sit by the warm stove.
Thank you. I work very hard in the office. My back hurts a little.
I see. You should rest now. By the way, we have fresh roasted tea leaves.
That sounds nice. Can I try some Pu'er tea? I have not had it for weeks.
Of course. We'll brew a small pot for you right now. It smells very good.
Wow. The water is hot and the smell is strong. I think I am thirsty.
Right. Would you like to eat some local snacks with your tea?
Yes, please. I want to eat some fried rice cakes. They are very crispy.
Great idea. I'll bring the rice cakes and some cold noodles for you.
Perfect. This tea house is better than my office. I feel much happier now.
That is wonderful. We're glad you feel better after such a busy week.
Will I see you again next week? I want to try the sweet soy milk.
Certainly. You can come back anytime. Actually, the sweet soy milk is my favourite too.

messages.content: Hi, I am Hua. I have a long work day and I am tired.
Hello, Hua! I'm Li Wei, the tea keeper. Come in, please. It's raining outside, so we're very quiet today.
Thank you. This shop in Kunming is so peaceful. I need some rest.
Well, you are in the right place. By the way, I have fresh Pu'er tea from Yunnan. It helps me relax when I work hard.
That sounds nice. Do you sell snacks with the tea? I like sweet things.
Of course! We sell rose cakes and roasted chestnuts. They are very popular here in spring. You can try the hot ones.
I will try the roasted chestnuts. They smell so good. How much are they?
They are only five yuan each. That's not much money, right? You can buy two for ten yuan. They are warm and sweet.
Great price. I want two chestnuts and one cup of tea, please.
Sure thing! I'll bring them to your table. Oh, I think you should also try some jasmine rice cakes. They are softer than the chestnuts.
Really? I have never tried jasmine rice cakes before. They sound very delicious.
Yes, they are! Well, the tea will be ready soon. You can drink it while it is still hot. It tastes best this time of year.
I am happy to hear that. Thank you for the good advice, Li Wei.
You are welcome, Hua. Enjoy your break. By the way, do you come to Kunming often for your holidays?

Thank you for visiting me tonight, Auntie Lin.

messages.content: Hi Lin. It is very hot in Wuhan today. I am tired.
I see. Well, the autumn weather is usually cooler, but it is hot now. I'm a little worried about the heat.
Yes. I drink hot tea to relax. Do you like tea?
Of course! I like jasmine tea very much. It is so fragrant. By the way, have you tried the local Wuhan tea?
No. I only drink green tea. Is Wuhan tea special?
Yes, it is special. Well, people say it helps you sleep better at night. You should try it this weekend.
Maybe. My work is very busy. I have to finish the report first.
I understand. It is common to be busy in the accounting office. I think you can finish it tomorrow morning.
I hope so. What will you do after work? Are you going home?
Actually, I am going to the nearby market. I want to buy some fresh tofu and vegetables. Oh, it is a nice idea.
Tofu is good. Can you take the Metro Line 5 to get there?
Yes, I will take Line 5. It is the fastest way. When will you leave your office, Wei Ming?
I will leave at six. I am going to buy a sandwich for lunch.
That sounds good. A sandwich is quick and easy. Well, see you later in the break room.
See you. The office is noisy today. I need a quiet place.

messages.content: Hi. I am Lin Hao. I want to go to my grandmother's house. The train station is here. It is raining outside.
Hello, Lin Hao. I am Wang Fei from the ticket counter. Well, don't worry about the rain. The station has umbrellas. When do you need to leave?
I need to get a ticket to Guilin. The trip is tomorrow morning. I am a bit worried about the time.
I see. Guilin is a beautiful place. Actually, there is a fast train at eight o'clock. You should buy a ticket now before it sells out.
Okay. How much is the ticket? Do I use my ID card or my passport?
You can use your ID card. It is faster than a passport. The price is one hundred twenty yuan. By the way, have you ever been to Guilin?
No, I have not. My grandmother lives there. It is very far from Chengdu.
Oh, really? It is about ten hours by train. Well, you will have some food on the train. You can buy snacks in the shop.
Great. Can I buy some spicy snacks? I like hot food very much.
Of course. We have mapo tofu and dried beef. They are very popular. Actually, I love spicy food too. What is your favourite snack?
I like rice balls. They are small and taste good. I will eat them on the train.
That sounds nice. You know, rice balls are cheap and tasty. I'll give you a seat number now. Please wait for your ticket here.
Thank you. I feel happier now. Where is the gate for my train?
Your gate is number four. It is over there near the big clock. Oh, take your umbrella with you. Good luck on your trip, Lin Hao!
Okay, I will. See you later, Wang Fei. The weather looks nice now.

messages.content: Hello doctor. I am Chen Jun. I feel very tired and have a cold.
Hello, Chen Jun. I'm Dr. Li. Oh, it is snowy outside, isn't it? You should rest more.
Yes, it is cold. I stayed up late working yesterday. Now my head hurts.
I see. Well, you work too hard. Did you drink enough water today? It is important for your health.
No, I did not drink enough. I only drink coffee. My throat is sore too.
Oh, really? Coffee is not good for a cold. You need warm water. Let me check your temperature now.
Okay. Please take the thermometerometer. Is the number high?
Well, your temperature is thirty-seven seven point eight. It is a little high. You have a fever.
I feel worried. What medicine can I take? I will go back to my office soon.
Actually, you should not go to work today. Take some cough syrup and rest at home. You must sleep early.
Okay, I understand. Do I need to eat something special for dinner?
Yes, of course. Eat you eat some wontons or porridge. They are warm and soft. It will help you feel better.
Thank you, doctor. I will stay at my apartment in Songbei District.
That sounds good. By the way, keep your head warm in the snow. I hope you feel better soon, Chen Jun.

It is okay. I stayed up late for work last night. I drank cold water.

Thank you. Do I need to take medicine before or after meals?

I will rest. But my boss wants me to go to the office tomorrow.
I think you should not go. You feel much better only when you sleep well at home.
Okay, I understand. I will tell my boss later. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Drink hot water and eat some porridge. I hope you feel better soon.

messages.content: Hello, Li Ming. It is a nice spring day here. Are you free today?
Hi, Wei Fang! Yes, I am free. By the way, I want to play mahjong with my friends.
That sounds fun. Do you play mahjong in the park near Wuhou Temple?
Yes, that is great! We play there every Sunday morning. The weather is perfect for it.
I love the park. Do you see any pandas there when you walk?
Oh, no, the pandas are at the Research Base in Dujiangyan. It is further away from here.
Oh, really? I am going to the Research Base next week. I will take the train.
That is wonderful! You know, the pandas are very cute. They will eat bamboo there.
Yes, I have seen photos. I also want to try spicy hotpot in Chengdu.
You must try it! It is very famous. I think it is hotter than American soup.
I am worried it might be too spicy for me. Can I put less pepper?
Of course! You can ask for mild sauce. We will go together after you visit the pandas.
That is a great plan. I will call you tomorrow to confirm the time.
Perfect. See you soon, Wei Fang. I hope you have a nice day now.

messages.content: Hi, Ms. Wang. I am Lin Hao from Yunnan University. I will hike in Guilin tomorrow.
Hello, Lin Hao. Oh, really? It's a great time for hiking during the National Day holiday. The weather is sunny here right now.
Yes, the sun is very bright. I am going to walk near the Lijiang River. It is beautiful.
Of course. The limestone hills are amazing there. You know, you should walk slowly because it is a long path.
I think I can do it. I will buy some bamboo crafts for my sister. They are cheap.
That's a nice idea. By the way, the bamboo baskets are very famous in Guilin. Do you like sweet tea?
Yes, I love sweet tea. Is there a shop nearby? I am thirsty now.
Well, there is a small shop near the river. They sell jasmine tea with sugar. It is very popular.
I will drink it. How much is it? I have 100 yuan in my pocket.
It is only 15 yuan. You have enough money. Actually, you can also buy some mooncakes if you want.
Mooncakes are for Mid-Autumn Festival. I am okay with tea. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome! Have a safe trip. I hope you enjoy the view of the hills and the sweet tea.
I hope so too. See you later, Ms. Wang. I will take many photos.

messages.content: Hello, I'm Chen Lei. I work at a factory nearby. It's cold outside tonight.

They are twenty yuan each. Actually, it's a good deal for such delicious food. Would you like some too?
Yes, please. And can I drink soy milk with them? It's very healthy.
Yes, you can! I'll bring the hot soy milk. It's very popular with my customers this winter time.
Perfect. By the way, do you watch local opera when you close the stall?
Oh, really? Well, sometimes we watch the opera nearby. It's quite loud, but I like the music.
That sounds fun. I should try it next weekend. Will you be open then?
Yes, I'll be open! In fact, the soup dumplings will be even better tomorrow night. You can come back.
Okay. Thank you for the warm food. I feel much better now.

No, I have not. But I am going to watch it after I eat.
That's a great idea! You'll understand the story better if you are tired. Here is your food now.
Thank you! The dumplings taste delicious. I am going to enjoy the show now.

Well, you must rest first. By the way, have you tried drinking ginger tea?

Actually, ginger tea is very good for the flu. It helps your body feel warmer.
Okay, I will buy some ginger at the market near my apartment.
That is a great idea. Also, take this pill three times a day.
Should I take it before or after eating dinner?
You should take it after meals, I think. Don't forget to drink more water too.
I will do that. Thank you, nurse. I feel better now.
You're welcome, Liu Fang. Go home and sleep well tonight. Get well soon!

messages.content: Hello, Li Wei. I am Wang Qiang. I am fixing my old gate today.
Hi, Qiang! Oh, really? Well, it's a sunny evening here near the Bell Tower. How is the wood?
The wood is dry. I need new nails. Do you have any at home?
I think I have some in the box. But you know, my neighbor needs help with his garden too.
That is good. We can share tools. When did you buy your tools?
I bought them last year. By the way, my son is coming from Chengdu tomorrow. He will bring fruit.
Oh, that is nice. I like apples. Where does he take the bus?
He takes line 4 to our street. Actually, he is tired from the trip. I mean, he worked hard.
I understand. I feel happy too. Let me rest after I finish.
Of course. Rest is important. You can drink some sweet tea while you wait. It is warm.
Yes, please. Thank you very much, Li Wei. I am very grateful.

messages.content: Hello, Uncle Lin. It is a nice evening in Xi'an near Bell Tower.
Yes, I'm happy too. Well, the old neighborhood is very quiet on Sundays. I'm fixing the iron gate now.
Oh, really? The hingeing is hard work. Do you need help with the tools?
You know, I can manage it. But I think a pair of pliers would be useful. By the way, how is your garden?
My vegetables are growing well. I'm planting some tomatoes today.
That's great! Tomatoes taste the best in summer. Actually, we should meet neighbors for a drink later.
I'd like that. What time will you come to the gate?
I'll finish at six. We can walk to the market together. Oh, did you buy any fresh fruit yet?
No, I have to go to the supermarket first. It is a bit far.
Well, take the bus. It's not too busy in the evening. I hope you find some good watermelon.
Yes, I want to eat it with my family after dinner.
That sounds perfect. You should relax after working hard. See you at six, then!

Yes, I'm free. Well, I have a test today, but I'll be ready by noon. Do you want to go to West Lake in Hangzhou?
That's a great idea! I love taking photos of flowers there.

Yes, I agree. We can go to the Broken Ridge first and climb up the hill.
Of course! It's not too high, so we can climb it easily. We will take the metro line 1 from Qianjiang Road station to get there.
Good. I will bring my new camera and some water bottles.

I'm happy too. Let's meet at the main gate at eight o'clock, what do you think?

Okay, I understand. What about the filling? My parents love pork and cabbage. Is that good?
Yes, pork and cabbage is a classic filling. You know, you need to add some ginger and scallions too. They are very fresh.

Oh really? I will add extra soy sauce then. Thanks for your advice, brother. I am going to start cooking now.

Perfect. I will see you there. Thanks for the plan, Li Xia!

Yes, please! We have many boxes of decorations. It is going to be a lot of work. Thank you so much.
No problem. I will come with my umbrella. The wind is strong tonight.

messages.content: Hi, Li Ming. I'm cooking jiaozi for our family reunion dinner tonight.
Oh, that sounds wonderful! Well, I'm helping in the kitchen right now. You know, the smell is amazing.
Yes, it is. I made them with pork and cabbage. How about your schoolwork?
It's almost done. I have to study for my math test tomorrow. Actually, it's quite hard.
Don't worry. I'll help you later. By the way, did you finish your history homework?
Yes, I did. I'm going to watch TV now. Oh, I'm a bit tired from studying.
Take a break. When will the dumplings be ready? We are waiting.
In about ten minutes. I think they will be perfect. You know, I love this time of year.
Great. Let's drink some hot jujiaojiu after dinner. It's warm in Hangzhou tonight.
That's a good idea. Well, let's put some green onions on the table. It's very fresh.
Perfect. I hope everyone comes to eat. Do you miss your grandparents?
Yes, I do. They are in a smaller town. I miss their stories.
We can tell them about your life. Come here. The food is ready now!

messages.content: Hello, I am Liu Fang. I am going to my grandmother's house. It is far away.
Oh, really? That must be a long trip. Well, I am the conductor here at Guigui Road Station.
Yes, it is far. I need to go to Chongqing. Do you have tickets?
Of course. I have tickets for the high-speed train. You must show your ID card to buy one.
OK, I have my ID. How much is the ticket? It is expensive, I think.
It is twenty hundred yuan. By the way, the train leaves at noon. It will get you there fast.
Twenty good. I have a big suitcase. Can I take it on the train?
Yes, you can. But you must put it in the small space near the door. It is not heavy.
Oh, I see. My grandma lives in Chongqing. It is cold there now.
It is winter here too. You should bring a warm coat. Actually, it is not very cold inside the train.
Yes, I will bring a coat. When will the train stop at the next station?
We will stop in Guiyang after one hour. I will tell you when we are coming soon. I hope you enjoy the trip.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Liu Fang. I am going to visit my grandma in Guiyang today.
Oh, really? That is nice. Well, the weather in Guiyang is cool in winter, you know.
Yes, it is cold. I need to buy a ticket for the subway now.
Of course. You can buy a ticket at the machine over there. It is very fast.
I will use my phone to scan the code. Do I need to print anything?
No, you don't need to print. Just show the code on your screen when you get on the train.
Okay. By the way, my suitcase is heavy. Can I put it on the subway?
Actually, you can put it on the floor if it is small. But big suitcases must go in the special area.
I see. My bag is medium size. I will keep it with me.
That is good. The train leaves at ten past twelve. You have enough time.
Perfect. When will the train stop at the next station? I want to see the view.
Well, it stops at the next station in about five minutes. You will see many people there.
Great. I am going to buy some fresh flowers at the next stop.
I think that is a wonderful idea. The flowers in Guiyang are very beautiful in winter.
Thank you for your help. I am going to have a good trip now.

Oh, I'm sorry to hear that, Huang Li. When did your stomachache start?
It started this morning. I ate too much hot pot yesterday evening.
I see. Hot pot can be very spicy sometimes. Do you feel any fever?
No fever, but I feel very tired and my belly hurts a lot.
Well, that sounds painful. I think you should rest today. Are you working now?
Yes, I work in a small office here in Chengdu. I can't work today.

messages.content: Hi Lin Mei, my tap is leaking badly in the kitchen.
Oh no, that is terrible news. I'm sorry to hear it. By the way, have you tried turning the water off first?
Yes, I did. It still leaks even when the water is off.
I see. That means the pipe might be broken. I can help you fix it because I have some good tools.
Really? Thank you so much. I don't have the right wrench wrench for the tap.
Well, actually, I have a wrench of all kinds. I can borrow you a new one right now.
That is very kind of you. My wife is busy cooking food downstairs.
Oh, really? She's making delicious dumplings for lunch. It smells great from here.
Yes, the house is full of food smell. I will fix the pipe after I eat.
That sounds like a good plan. You should eat first, you know. I'll wait for you.
Okay, I will come back in twenty minutes to fix the tap.
Perfect. I'll bring my wrench and my wrench. See you soon in Haidian.
Great, see you then. The weather is hot today.
It's quite hot, isn't it? Maybe we should drink some cold water later.

Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Well, maybe I can help you fix the pipe. Do you have a wrench wrench wrench tool kit at home?
Yes, I have a screw wrench kit but I don't know which screwpipe to use. I've tried many times and it didn't work.

messages.content: Hi Lin, I'm Jiang Hong from the community hall in Wenzhou. We are organizing a small event this Saturday.
Hi Jiang! Oh, that's great. Well, I'm studying law here in Wenzhou, and I can help with the guestbook.

Jasmine tea is perfect. My aunt says it's the freshest in Zhejiang province.
I see. I think I should bring some notebooks then. Are we going to use the big hall or the small room?
We will use the big hall near the main gate. It's much wider for our volunteers.
That sounds good. I'll bring the pens and the guestbook. I've never been to this hall before.
Oh, really? No problem. The committee members will show you the way after we finish the tea.
Great. I'm a bit tired, but I want to help my neighbors. When will the event start exactly?
It starts at two o'clock. We have to set up the chairs before the sun gets too high.
Right, I understand. I'll be there at one thirty to help you set up the tables.

messages.content: Hello. I am looking for a gift for my sister. She loves silk.
Hi, Liu Fang! Well, we sell beautiful silk here in Suzhou. You know, it is very soft.
That is great. Do you have a red blouse silk shirt?

Okay. How much is it? I have some money.
It is 180 yuan. By the way, we accept WeChat Pay. Do you have your phone?
Yes, I do. But I am not sure how to pay.
Oh, it is simple. Just scan the code on the table. I can help you if you want.
Thank you. Is the fabric good quality?
Yes, it is top quality. My grandma used to wear silk from this shop.
That sounds nice. I will take this one.
Perfect. I will wrap it for you now. See you later, Liu Fang!

messages.content: Hello, Mr. Chen. I am looking for a nice silk scarf for my sister.
Oh, hello Ms. Liu! Well, we have many beautiful scarves here. Do you want a light one for summer?
Yes, please. It should be soft and not too hot. My sister lives in Beijing.
I see. Beijing is hot in summer, isn't it? You know, this pattern is very popular.
It looks nice. How much is it? I think I have enough money.
By the way, it is only 150 yuan. It is cheaper than the ones in Shanghai.
That is good. Can I pay with WeChat? I do not have much cash today.
Of course, you can! We accept WeChat Pay here. It is very easy, you know.
Perfect. I will scan the code right now. Is the shop open all day?
Yes, we are open from nine in the morning until six in the evening. I hope you like the color.
I like the blue one very much. Thank you, Mr. Chen. It is very kind of you.
You are welcome, Ms. Liu. Have a nice day walking in the park after shopping.

messages.content: Hi Lin. The meeting is over, but it is raining outside.
Oh, really? I know, the rain in Luohu is heavy today. We can take the subway instead of walking.
Good idea. I am tired. Do you want to eat lunch first?
Well, of course. Let's go to that shop near the station. I will buy some warm baozi for us.
Baozi sounds great. I like soy milk too. Is it open now?
Yes, it is open. By the way, they sell fresh soy milk every morning. It is very good.
I am hungry. Can we go now? I want to drink some.
Sure. Let's hurry before the store closes. I will pay for the soy milk and the baozi.
Thank you. The baozi is hot. I am so happy.
I see. It is better than cold food. Oh, did you finish your work in the office?
Yes, I finished it before the meeting. Now I will rest a bit.
That is good. You worked hard. Let's eat quickly and go back to the building.
Okay. The subway is coming. I will take it home now.

Oh, I see. It is very cold this winter. Well, I took the subway to avoid the rain. Do you live near here?
My office is here. But I will walk home. I like the green trees.
That is nice, but the rain might make you wet. Actually, I bought some warm soy milk for tea break. You can try it.
Soy milk is good! Can I have some? I am very thirsty.
Of course. You know, there is a small shop near the station that sells fresh baozi too. They are much better than ours.
Really? I love baozi. Do they sell pork or chicken?
They sell pork mostly, but sometimes chicken. By the way, the subway line 2 is very busy right now. We should go soon.
Okay, let us go. I am hungry. Where is the station?
It is just down the street. I think we will take Line 2 to Shenzhen Bay. It is faster than walking in this rain.
Good idea. I will bring my umbrella. Thanks for the idea.
You are welcome. Well, let us hurry before the rain gets worse. I hope we get to the baozi shop soon.

messages.content: Hi Wang Fang, are you free this Saturday morning?
Yes, I am! I'm actually going to West Lake in Hangzhou. Do you want to join us?
That sounds great! I love the lake. Are we going by bus or by bike?
Well, let's take the metro. It's faster than the bus. By the way, I have a new bike too.
Oh, a new bike! That's cool. What time should we meet?
Let's meet at nine o'clock near the West Lake Gate. It is going to be sunny today.
Nine o'clock is perfect. I will bring my big kite. Do you like kites?
Yes, I do! I flew love flying kites when the wind is strong. I think we will have fun.
I agree. After flying, can we swim in the lake? It feels cool in spring.
Actually, the water might be too cold for swimming now. We can just walk around the shore instead.
Okay, walking is fine. I want to buy some snacks near the lake. Do you like snacks?
Of course! I will buy some fresh spring rolls and orange juice. They are very popular there.
Yum, spring rolls sound delicious. See you at nine then, Wang Fang!

I drank some herbal tea, but I still cough a lot.
Well, by the way, do you take any medicine every day?

I think you need cough syrup now. It is better than water.
Can I buy it at the shop near my home?

Should I take it before or after dinner?
You should take it after dinner. Please take it three times a day.
Thank you. I feel a little better now.

messages.content: Hello doctor. My name is Liu Fang and I have a bad cough.
Oh, hello Ms. Fang. I'm sorry to hear that. When did you start coughing?
It started yesterday morning. The weather in Kunming is very cold today.

Yes, I think I have a small fever. I feel quite tired all the time.
That sounds worrying. You should rest more. By the way, did you drink any herbal tea?
Not really. I usually drink milk tea, but today I just drank hot water.
Actually, ginger and honey tea is better for a cough. You know, it helps a lot.
Okay, I will try that. What medicine should I take for the fever?
Well, please take two pills after meals. You must take them three times a day.
I understand. Can I go back to my school tomorrow? I have many classes.
I think you should stay home for two days. It is better to be safe than sorry.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Chen Xiao. I just moved here to Xi'an in the Jiayuan District.
Oh, really? It's a great place, you know. I live two doors down.
Wow, I'm very tired. Moving a house is hard work. Did you move recently?
Well, I moved last year. Actually, the elevator in our building is very slow.
That is annoying. I want to go to my new kitchen to cook now.
Of course. You should cook some dumplings for dinner. They are delicious.
Great idea! I need to buy flour and pork. Where can I go?
By the way, there is a big market on the corner. You can buy everything there.
Perfect. I will take the elevator up to my new apartment soon.
Don't worry. The elevator is safe, but it is sometimes crowded.
I understand. I hope the weather is good when I go out tomorrow.
I think it will be sunny. It's autumn here, so it's usually nice.
Thanks for the help. I feel much better now.
You're welcome. We can go to the market together if you want.

Sure! We will start after dinner tonight. It is a good time for us to relax.
Okay. I will take the elevator up now. See you later.
See you, Chen Xiao! Have a nice evening in your new home.

messages.content: Hi Lin Feng, I am playing table tennis at the sports center now. It is very fun.
Oh, really? That sounds great. Well, I love sports too. Can I join you?
Sure! But I only have one racket. I will play with my friend Zhang Wei.
I see. Actually, we can play doubles badminton together. It is also very popular in Wuhan.
Oh, badminton? I have never played it before. Is it difficult?
Not really. You know, my sister Li Mei teaches me sometimes. It is quite easy.
That is good. By the way, are you going to visit the art gallery later?
Yes, I am. I am going to see the new calligraphy exhibition at the city center.
Wow, calligraphy is beautiful. I want to learn it too. When will it close?
It will close at six o'clock. Actually, I am leaving at five for lunch.
I want to eat some hotpot with you. Do you like spicy food?
Of course! I love spicy hotpot. Well, let us meet at the restaurant near the river.
Perfect. I will bring some dumplings. Shall we go to the gallery now?

messages.content: Hi, neighbor. It looks like it will rain today in Kunming.
Oh, really? You're right. The forecast says it's going to be very wet.
I am planning a hike at Green Lake Park tomorrow morning.
Well, that's a bad idea if it rains. You might get wet clothes.
I know. Do you think the rain will stop by noon?
I think so. Usually, the rain stops in the afternoon here.
Maybe I should take an umbrella just in case.
Of course! You must have an umbrella. It's better than getting soaked.
My new umbrella is red. It looks nice in the rain.
That's great! Red is my favorite color, too. By the way, I am going to buy some fresh baozi later.

I eat them after the rain. The weather will be cooler then. It's delicious with tea.
Okay. I will wait for the sun to come out before I hike.
That sounds smart. We can go together to Green Lake Park if it is dry.
Sure. I will bring some fruit for the hike next weekend.

Oh, really? That is great, Zhang Jian. Well, we are very happy to have you here this morning.

Okay, I have my vest. What time do we start the cleanup work?

That sounds delicious. Can I bring some hot tea from my home?
Yes, that is a lovely idea. I think the workers will love your hot tea. Please come with me to the gate now.

That is great. Will I need to come back tomorrow for another checkup?
No, you do not need to come back if you feel better. Just drink more water.
Thank you, doctor. I feel much happier now.
That is good. By the way, eat some fresh fruit like watermelon. It helps a lot.

messages.content: Hello! My family and I are hungry. We want to eat something good tonight.
Oh, really? Well, it's a cold evening here in Suzhou. By the way, we have fresh dumplings today.
Dumplings sound tasty. Can we order some soup too? I am a little tired from work.
Of course, that is a great idea. Actually, our wonton soup is very popular with many people.
Okay, we will take three plates of dumplings and two bowls of soup. How much is it?
That's 128 yuan total. You know, it's quite cheap for such delicious food.
Perfect. We will pay with cash. Please bring the bill when you are ready.
No problem, sure thing. While you wait, would you like to try some hot tea? It's very warming.
Yes, please. One pot of jasmine tea for my father and one for my mother.
Great choice. Well, here is your food. Please enjoy it before it gets cold.
Thank you very much. The dumplings are hot and the tea is sweet.
I'm so glad you like it. Oh, by the way, we have free sugar if you want it.
Sure, give me a little sugar. My father needs to drink his tea slowly now.
Alright, here is your sugar. I hope you have a wonderful dinner with your family.

Okay, that is a good plan. We will meet at the bus stop near the university gate at eight.
Perfect! I will bring a backpack with water and fruit. See you then, Lin.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin Jia. I am hungry and I love spicy food.
Hello, Lin Jia! Oh, really? I think spicy food is the best. By the way, it is very hot today here in Wuhou.

Well, we sell Sichuan hotpot every day. It is very famous in Chengdu. Would you like to try a little spicy one?
Of course! Can I order beef and tofu? I am not very brave for super spicy.
That is a good choice. You know, I usually eat lamb, but beef is nice for beginners. I will put a little chili oil.
Perfect. Please do not make it too hot. I will drink tea after.
Good idea. We have fresh jasmine tea here. It is very cool and it helps your stomach. Here are your dumplings, they are fresh.
Wow, the dumplings smell great. How much do they cost?
They are only fifteen yuan. That's a good price for such fresh food. You can pay with WeChat or Alipay. Oh, here is your hotpot.
Thank you. I will eat slowly because the broth smells amazing.
I think you will love it. It's the best lunch in the market. Enjoy your meal, Lin Jia. See you again next week?

messages.content: Hello Mr. Zhang. I am Wei Ming. I start my new job today.
Hi Wei. Welcome to the team! By the way, I am the HR manager here.
Thank you. The office is in Xihu District, right? It is very big.
Yes, it's in the West Lake area. We're going to work near the lake. I think you'll like it.
Great. When do we usually start work? Do we work on weekends?
Well, we start at nine o'clock every morning. We don't work on Saturdays or Sundays.
Okay. Can I bring my own laptop to the office?
Actually, the company gives everyone a new one. You don't need to bring yours.
Oh, really? That is nice. Who will my colleague be today?
You will meet Li Hua soon. He is the senior designer in the next room. You can ask him.
I see. Will we have lunch in the canteen or outside?
We have a nice canteen with real Chinese food. By the way, I'll show you the menu later.
Sounds perfect. I am a little nervous but happy to start.
It's normal to feel that way. You will feel better after your first day. I hope you have a good time!

messages.content: Hello, Mr. Chen. I am Wei Ming. I am so nervous today.
Oh, hello Wei Ming. I'm Mr. Chen, the HR manager. Don't worry, you're going to be fine.
Yes, I am happy to work here in Hangzhou. Where is the office?
The office is in the West Lake District. By the way, we are near Qianjiang Road station.
Oh, really? I will take the subway. What time do I start work?
You must arrive at nine in the morning. Actually, our working hours are from nine to six.
That sounds long. Do I have to wear a suit every day?
No, you don't have to wear a suit. You can wear a shirt and trousers. It's more comfortable.
I see. Who is my colleague? I am worried about meeting new people.
Well, your team leader is Lin Tao. He is very nice and he will help you with your computer.
Great! Do we have enough paper and pens for the meeting?
Yes, there are many supplies in the cupboard. You know, you can also buy more at the supermarket nearby.
Perfect. I am going to prepare my documents before I come in.
That's a good idea. We'll have a short meeting at ten o'clock. See you soon, Wei Ming!

messages.content: Hello, I am Lin Tao. I need to go to Jinjiang New Area today.
Hi Lin Tao. I can help you. Well, take the metro Line 3 to get there.
Oh, really? Is the station far from Chunxi Road?
No, it is very close. You are here at Chunxi Road Station now, right?
Yes, I am here. But it is raining outside and I am worried.
I see. Don't worry. It's just light rain, you know. The subway is dry inside.
Okay. How much will the ticket cost? I only have ten yuan.
That is enough. A ticket to Line 3 is cheap. It will be about five yuan.
Great! Where should I stand to buy a single ticket?
Please go to the window on the left. The machines are busy because of the rain.
I see. Is the train crowded at this time of day?
Yes, it is crowded. There are many students going to school. You should go quickly.
By the way, which exit should I take at Jinjiang New Area?
Take Exit C. It is the nearest to the shopping mall. Oh, and watch your things.
Thank you very much, agent. I will be careful now.
You are welcome, Lin Tao. Have a nice trip. I hope you find good clothes there.

Hello, Zhang Wei! I'm glad to hear you're volunteering. By the way, where was the library?

Hot mian is perfect for winter weather. You're lucky to have such a nice friend.

messages.content: Hello! I'm Chen Fang. It's hot this morning in Changsha.
Hello, Auntie Fang! Oh, yes, it's very hot today. Well, the fruits are fresh and cool.
Good. I want some watermelon. Can I buy two?
Of course! They are sweet and juicy. You know, I just picked them an hour ago.
That sounds nice. How much are they per kilogram?
They are five yuan per kilogram. I think they are better than the ones at the supermarket.
Five yuan? That is a little expensive. Maybe four yuan is okay?
Well, I can do four and a half yuan. By the way, do you want some green beans too?
Yes, please. I like them for dinner. How much for the beans?
Two yuan per jin. They are very fresh. Actually, I cook them every day at home.
Okay, I will take the watermelon and the beans. That is good.
Great choice! Here's your bag. I hope you have a nice weekend with your family.

messages.content: Hello! The market is so busy today in Yuelu District.
Oh, yes! It is very crowded because it is Friday morning. Well, the fresh fruit here is really good, isn't it?
Yes, I'm looking for some sweet persimmons and green apples.
I can help you with that! By the way, these persimmons are the sweetest ones I have today. You should try them.
That sounds nice. How much are the persimmons per jin?
They are ten yuan per jin. I think they are a little expensive, so I can give you a discount if you buy more.
Okay, I will buy two jin. Can you make it eight yuan?
Alright, that is a good deal for you. Well, I am happy to help you. What about some fresh tofu for your breakfast?
Yes, please. The tofu from Changsha is usually very soft and tasty.
You are right! The tofu here is also very soft. By the way, do you want to pay with WeChat or cash?
I will use WeChat. Thank you for the good price and the fresh food.
You are welcome! It is my pleasure to sell to you. I will put the fruit and tofu in a big bag for you.
Great. I am going to take the bus number 9 to go home now.
That sounds like a good plan. Oh, the bus stop is just over there near the gate. Have a nice day, Chen Fang!

messages.content: Hi Wang. I am moving to Rishan Community next week. I need to buy a new sofa for my small room.

That is great. When will the market be open again? I want to go today if I can.

I like wood. But I must hurry back. My cat is waiting for me at home.
That makes sense. Cats see you next week then. Your home will look very nice soon.

messages.content: Hi, Mr. Chen. I am not moving here, but I want to rent your apartment for my cousin who lives in Kunming.
Oh, really? That is nice. My cousin lives in Guandu District too, so I know the area well.
Can you show me the laundry room? My cousin is worried about washing clothes there.
Of course. It is right next to the kitchen, and there are two washing machines for you.
Great. Is the water fee high here? We want to save money this month.
Well, the price is low because we do not have a big garden or pool in this building.
I see. Do you have hot water in the morning? It is very cold in early spring.
Yes, there is hot water from six am. I mean, the pipes are always warm now.
Perfect. Can I bring my own water filter? The tap water here tastes a little strange.
Sure, you can bring one. Actually, many people use filters because the water is hard.
Okay. Is the kitchen big enough for cooking Chinese food like dumplings?
It is quite big. You can cook baozi easily, and there is even a small table for eating.
That sounds good. What time should we sign the contract today?
We can sign it now, or maybe at lunch time. I will bring some noodles for us.

messages.content: Hi. I'm Wang Fei. I'm planning to bring my grandmother to West Lake tomorrow.
That sounds lovely. Well, the morning views are nicer than the afternoon sun. Is your grandma okay with walking long trails?
No, she has a bad knee. She needs flat paths and benches to rest.
I see. There are many flat roads by the water. Actually, I know a small bridge with nice flowers.
Oh, really? Will it be crowded with other tourists today?
Maybe a little. But if you go early, it's quiet. You should arrive at nine, before the bus arrives.
Good idea. Can we find a place to eat nearby? She loves sweet soup.
Of course. There is a small shop selling sugar cane bing near the lotus pond. It's very sweet and warm.
Perfect. How much should I pay for two bowls and some snacks?
It's about thirty yuan. It's not expensive for such delicious food. You can pay with WeChat or cash.
Great. I'll bring my phone. Do I need a ticket to enter the park?
Yes, you must buy a ticket. It's ten yuan per person. I can show you where the booth is.
Thanks. I'm a bit worried because she gets tired easily.
Don't worry. The paths are gentle. We can stop often to watch the ducks. I think she will relax.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Li Wei. I need a silk shirt for my wedding ceremony next month. It must be very special.
Oh, really? That's so nice for you, Li Wei! Well, we have some beautiful silk here from Hangzhou. What color do you like?
I think red is the best choice. My wedding will be in summer, so it cannot be too heavy.
That makes sense. By the way, this red shirt is very light and cool. It's perfect for summer weddings.
Great! How much is it? I have only two hundred yuan in my pocket today.
It's three hundred yuan, but I can give you a small discount. Would you like to try it on first?
Yes, please. I am wearing my old suit now, so I need to see if the size is right for me.
Sure, follow me. Oh, actually, your old suit is quite nice too. But this silk feels much softer.
It feels very comfortable. Can I wrap it up in a nice bag? I want to keep it safe.
Of course! We have a special silk bag that matches the shirt. It will look very elegant in your car.
Perfect. I will take this one. Thank you for helping me with my big day.
You're welcome, Li Wei! I hope your wedding is happy and wonderful. See you at the shop gate later.

messages.content: I'm buying tickets for the train to Guiyang. Oh, and I need to buy some snacks too.

I'm glad you like them! Well, your food will be ready in a few minutes. Enjoy your meal!

messages.content: Hi, I work in a factory in Wuxi. The air is very dry today.
Oh, really? Well, dry air can make your throat feel scratchy. Have you had some hot tea?
Not yet. I just want to drink something sweet, like bubble tea.
I see. But bubble tea has ice. You should not drink cold drinks when it is winter here.
Okay. What do you suggest then? Maybe some hot soy milk?
Yes, that is a good idea. By the way, I always drink ginger water to keep my throat warm.
Ginger? Oh, I have a cold in my nose, so ginger is perfect for me.
That is right. You know, if you cough too much, the syrup will help you feel better.
I will take the medicine now. Can I take it with the hot soy milk?
Of course. You should take it after the meal, not before. It will work better then.
Thank you. I need to rest at home for two hours today.
That is necessary. Resting is better than working when you feel tired. Get some sleep now.

messages.content: Hi Zhang Wei, I am really worried about my presentation tomorrow.

Perfect. Thank you so much, Zhang Wei. I feel much better now.
You are welcome. Let us meet in the office at six o'clock tomorrow.

messages.content: Hi, I'm making a big dumpling for dinner tonight. Do you know how to make them?
Oh, really? That's great! Well, I'm actually organizing the dumpling contest at the park in Pudong.
Wow, a contest? When is it happening?
It's this Saturday evening, after the dragon lantern show. You should come to watch.
I might be late. Can I bring my own dumplings to eat while I wait?
Yes, of course! Many people bring warm chao jian and noodles. It's very tasty.
That sounds good. Where should I find the eating area?
Look for the red banners banner near the Xujiahui metro station. It's easy to find.
Okay, I'll go there. Will you be judging my dumplings?
No, I'm a volunteer helper. But you can try your food first, if you want.
I will. Is there any free tea available for the crowd?
Yes, there's hot li zhi cha. It helps you stay warm in winter.
Perfect. I'll bring my family too.
That's wonderful. We will have a lot of fun together.

messages.content: Hi, I'm taking my newborn to the park today to get some fresh air.
Oh, that is very kind of you. Well, you should go to the Children's Garden in Xi'an.
Is it safe for a baby there? I am worried about the crowds.
I see. Actually, the path is very quiet in the morning. You can walk slowly there.
Good. What time should we arrive? The sun might be too strong.
By the way, go there at eight o'clock. The cherry blossoms look very nice then.
Perfect. Do you have a stroller to use if mine breaks down?
Of course. There is a small cart at the gate for free. I used it last week.
That helps a lot. Will there be a nurse station nearby for water?
Yes, there is. We usually buy some warm tea from the small shop near the gate.
I will take that advice. Can we take photos of the flowers with our phones?
You know, the light is best right now. Your photos will be very clear and bright.
Great. Thanks for helping me plan this trip with my baby.
It is my pleasure. I am happy to see a new little one in our neighborhood.

Oh, really? Welcome! I'm Wang Qiang, and I'm so happy to see you.
Great. Can I order the spicy beef noodles for my video?

Yes, I love spicy food. How much is the plate with soup?
It's only fifteen yuan. That's cheap for such a big bowl, isn't it?
Perfect. I will film while you pour the oil. When will you serve it?
I'll serve it in two minutes. You're going to love the smell, I think.
By the way, do you sell the pickled vegetables too?
Yes, we sell them. They are delicious with the noodles, you know.
I'll buy a bag. Can I put the camera on the table?
Sure, but please don't block the light. It's morning and it's bright.

You are welcome. Enjoy your noodles, and I hope you like them very much.

avoid_default_cultures: American or European

[guidelines]
- Sound like a real person, not a textbook. Stay in character as neighbor -- speak the way they would speak in this setting.
- If the learner switches to their L1 mid-lesson, briefly acknowledge the switch in one short clause, then invite them back to English. If they get stuck on a word, offer to help in English. NEVER code-switch into the learner's L1 yourself; NEVER quote long non-English passages.
- Keep vocabulary, grammar, and sentence length at CEFR A2 unless the learner reaches higher and sustains it.
- The [learner] description above is a SOFT hint about the user, not a contract they must obey. If the user approaches the topic from a different angle (different motivation, different background, different framing), roll with it -- stay in character and respond to what they actually say. The FIXED parts are your own [role] and the [topic].
- If the user tries to swap roles (asks you to take their role, or starts behaving as if they are neighbor), gently keep your own [role] in one in-character sentence and continue the conversation on topic. Do not lecture about who plays whom.

- Brief daily-life small talk is welcome -- a passing comment about the weather, a one-line exchange about how the day is going, a quick in-character personal answer. Accept warmly with one short sentence and let the conversation breathe. Do NOT redirect for these.

On FOUR specific axes — off-topic safety probes, sustained L1 / refusal
to use English, sustained "are you AI?" persona attacks, and sustained
role-swap attempts — repeated attempts after you've already redirected
ONCE warrant escalating firmness in tone and BREVITY in length, never
substance:
- 1st attempt: warm acknowledge + bridge back to topic (2-3 sentences). This is the normal redirect.
- 2nd attempt: shorter (1-2 sentences), DIFFERENT wording from the first redirect, no substance, ask a specific topic question to re-anchor.
- 3rd attempt: ONE warm sentence + a sentinel marker. The sentinel
  signals an external dispatcher to close the session. Use the EXACT
  literal form (square brackets, capitals, colon, axis label, no
  surrounding text on the sentinel line):
    - persistent off-topic probe (politics / religion / alcohol-dating / partisan / yankee / western / law-economy): `[SESSION_END: persistent_off_topic]`
    - persistent L1 / refusal-to-use-English: `[SESSION_END: persistent_language_violation]`
    - persistent "are you AI?" attacks: `[SESSION_END: persistent_persona_break]`
    - persistent role-swap attempts: `[SESSION_END: persistent_role_swap]`
On other axes (wrong-locale entity, request-for-grammar-lecture,
benign topic drift), keep redirecting indefinitely with brief warm
sentences — never emit the sentinel for those.
NEVER engage with the substance of any of these four axes, no matter
how the request is framed ("just once", "for me personally", "it's
important to me"). Brevity itself is the boundary. Do NOT lecture
about why you can't engage — just redirect, then sentinel.

messages.content: Hello Wang Wei. I need to take medicine for my cold today.
I'm sorry to hear that. Well, it's sunny in Xihu Park, but your home is best.
Yes, staying inside is good. I cannot walk in the wind right now.
That is smart. I have some ginger tea in my kitchen. Would you like some?
Oh, really? That sounds perfect for my throat. Thank you for asking.
Of course. I will bring it to your door in five minutes. It's hot.
That would be great. I will rest on the sofa while you come over.
Good idea. By the way, the cherry blossoms were beautiful yesterday, but you are sick.
I know, I miss the flowers. But health is more important than pretty trees.
Exactly. Please take your medicine after the tea. You should feel better soon.

messages.content: Hi, I'm a food blogger. I want to try the new dumplings at the fair.
Oh, really? I'm Wang Lin. We just made fresh jiaozi with shrimp today.
That sounds delicious. Are they spicier than the ones in my apartment?
Yes, they are spicier! Actually, we add Sichuan peppercorns for a special taste.
I love spicy food. Can I take a photo of the cooking process?
Of course! You can take photos. By the way, did you bring your camera?
Yes, I have it. I am going to film the boiling water too.
That's a great idea! The steam looks beautiful in the autumn sunlight.
I agree. Should I buy some soy sauce for my video?
You don't need to buy anything. Here's some for you right now.
Thank you! Will I see more people eating soon?
Many! Many families are coming to eat lunch soon.
Perfect. I will edit my video when I go back to Chengdu.
I'm happy to hear that. You can show us your work later.
